jobs.title: Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join Our Team as a Project Coordinator!

Are you ready to take on a pivotal role in our construction projects? We’re seeking a **Project Coordinator** to join our dynamic team. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-paced office environment, coordinating with clients, vendors, and subcontractors to ensure projects are completed on time and to the highest standards.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Pre\-Construction Planning**: Prepare checklists and obtain necessary documents.
* **Permit Acquisition**: Secure city/county permits using our permit runner system.
* **Material Coordination**: Provide clients with material lists based on blueprints and project scope.
* **Subcontractor Management**: Schedule subcontractors, negotiate contracts, and manage payments.
* **Scheduling**: Maintain project schedules in Google Calendar and coordinate vendor timelines.
* **Communication**: Provide daily and weekly (Sunday) updates to clients and maintain constant communication with vendors, customers, project managers, and quality control teams.
* **Quality Control**: Create daily schedules for Field QC and submit/follow up on Requests for Information (RFIs).
* **Financial Oversight**: Approve weekly subcontractor payments and release owner invoices when due.
* **Project Closeout**: Complete end\-of\-project checklists and maintain completion schedules.
* **Daily Reporting**: Fill out end\-of\-day checklists to ensure smooth operations.

Work Schedule:

* Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 4 PM – enjoy your evenings and weekends free!

Qualifications:

* Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills.
* Strong communication and negotiation abilities.
* Proficiency with Google Calendar and standard office software.
* A proactive mindset with a passion for problem\-solving.
* Experience in construction or project coordination is required.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $72,000\.00 \- $84,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Project Coordinator will support the planning, implementation, coordination, and expansion of early wealth\-building initiatives led by the UCLA CalKIDS Institute. Reporting directly to the Principal Investigator and working closely with Institute leadership, the Project Coordinator will serve as the primary liaison between the Institute and a broad network of partners, including community\-based organizations, educational institutions, public agencies, financial capability providers, and statewide coalitions. The primary responsibility of this position will be overseeing the day\-to\-day implementation of the CalKIDS Institute Building Wealth at Tax Time Initiative, a multi\-year effort designed to integrate CalKIDS, 530A ("Trump") Accounts, HOPE Accounts, and other asset\-building opportunities into Volunteer Income Tax Assistance (VITA) and Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) outreach ecosystems. The Project Coordinator will coordinate and implement partner engagement, training, outreach, data collection, and ongoing communication with participating VITA coalitions and community partners. In addition to supporting the Building Wealth at Tax Time Initiative, the Project Coordinator will contribute to other Institute activities related to early wealth building, including development and dissemination of training resources, stakeholder engagement, research implementation, community outreach, policy initiatives, convenings, and partnerships that advance financial resilience and asset\-building opportunities for low\-income households. The position requires strong project management, relationship\-building, communication, and organizational skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple initiatives and work effectively with diverse stakeholders across California.

jobs.title: Brownfields Program Coordinator - West
jobs.description:
Toeroek Associates, Inc. is seeking a **Brownfields Program Coordinator to** coordinate all phases of Targeted Brownfields Assessments in the western U.S. The successful candidate will provide comprehensive coordination of up to ten concurrent Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments, supporting a team that assesses the nature and extent of contamination at Brownfields sites.


Periodic travel of up to 25% is required. Worksite locations are distributed across the western United States, including Hawaii and Alaska. Candidates must be geographically located within reasonable proximity of West Coast states in order to support operations and facilitate fieldwork.

**Duties include**

* Provide comprehensive coordination of logistics, staffing, reporting, and deliverables across multiple active sites.
* Oversee project managers, including cost estimates, work schedules, and staff assignments to maintain on\-time and on\-budget performance.
* Provide oversight to field staff and subcontractors conducting site investigation and remediation projects for approximately 15 field sites located in the West region.
* Ensure that project deliverables, milestones, and budgets are met.
* Work closely with senior managers in the coordination of work activities to meet milestones, budgetary limits, deadlines, or other performance indicators.
* Communicate professionally and effectively with government customers and project partners.
* Prepare, review, and submit well\-written technical reports in accordance with regulations, applicable guidance and policies, and internal quality control standards.
* Conduct Phase I and II Environmental Site Assessments (ESAs).
* Lead field activities, including soil, groundwater, sediment, and soil gas sample collection; geological logging and interpretation; and oversight of investigation and remediation subcontractors, including laboratories and excavation and drilling companies
* Support providing soil and groundwater assessments, soil gas sampling, asbestos inspections, lead\-based paint assessments, geophysical surveys, and waste determinations
* Prepare technical reports and other documents on topics associated with site characterization, remedial optimization, and remedy implementation
* Recognize technical discrepancies in analytical results and making appropriate corrections following standard procedures
* Provide support in organizing public meetings to address the findings of ESAs

**Required Education/Experience**


BS degree in Engineering, Geology, Environmental Science, or related field with four years of practical experience related to environmental field sampling and two years as a field\-team lead. Preferred work experience with contaminated site characterization and remediation at contaminated sites, including Superfund, Brownfields, or RCRA Corrective Action sites. Strong knowledge of federal and state environmental laws and regulations under Federal (e.g., Superfund, RCRA, Brownfields), state, or other cleanup programs. Experience with Phase I and Phase II ESAs and experience conducting quantitative analyses using Microsoft Excel

**REQUIRED CREDENTIALS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* 40\-Hour HAZWOPER

**PROFESSIONAL SKILLS:**

* Demonstrated attributes to become a strong consultant team player, eagerness to learn and grow, self\-starter who takes the initiative, versatile, and service\-oriented
* Effective written/verbal communication and organization/analytical skills; experience writing and compiling technical data and reports
* Ability to multitask, maintain flexibility, travel, and work independently with minimal supervision
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once


The anticipated hiring salary range for this remote position is $75,000\-140,000 DOQ. Pay consideration is given based on geographic location, relevant work experience, and education. Toeroek offers a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, Life, LTD, STD, and 401 (k). Qualified applicants should include their resume with their completed application for further consideration.


Toeroek Associates is a dynamic small business provider of specialty consulting and analysis services to the U.S. Government. Toeroek offers a collaborative and congenial work environment with a team of passionate staff dedicated to finding solutions to complex problems in the fields of environment, records and knowledge management, and national security. Our multi\-disciplined environmental staff includes scientific, legal, and engineering experts who support federal and state government entities in compliance, removal and remediation, field services, site assessments, oversight, historical and technical research, litigation, cost recovery, and community engagement.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**
The SCGA Junior Golf Foundation’s mission is to develop an inclusive golf community that enables kids to thrive on and beyond the course. Through its programs, SCGA Junior Golf Foundation works to fulfill its mission by creating affordable access to golf for all youth, teaching smart decision\-making skills, on and off the course, and developing a culture of healthy lifestyles. Founded in 1983, SCGA Junior Golf Foundation is the philanthropic arm of the Southern California Golf Association. SCGA Junior Golf Foundation’s programs emphasize both player and youth development by providing a fun, safe, and engaging community for players, parents, and coaches. **Position Summary:**
The Program Coordinator is a full\-time, non\-exempt opportunity assisting with the operation, growth, and exposure of the player \& youth development programs (herein PYD) focused in the community. The Program Coordinator and PYD team implement positive youth development, and golf and athlete development programming, for juniors within the community. The Program Coordinator assists with curriculum development, as well as overall growth and development of youth coaches. The incumbent will be assigned to work at various field locations within the defined geographical boundary and community. This position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, with a starting hourly rate of $24\.00\. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:*** Accountable for the oversight and implementation of all program and safety policies in San Fernando Valley, including program facilitation at Woodley Lakes, Hansem Dam, and Van Nuys golf courses
* Implements positive youth development and team culture building best practices in all aspects of programming and beyond
* Serves as a lead golf instructor at beginner, intermediate and advanced level programming and other events as necessary while promoting best practices regarding safety and SCGA Junior Golf Foundation policies
* Organizes and develops programming/activities/events in accordance with the SCGA Junior Golf Foundation’s mission and PYD program goals and objectives to include those focused on community building.
* Implements and manages program modifications to ensure program goals are achieved.
* Provides supervision, feedback and training on a regular basis to coaches.
* Recruits, schedules and conducts one\-on\-one lessons.
* Administers equipment fittings.
* Develops and maintains community, facility, stakeholder partnerships and relationships for the benefit of the program.
* Assists in identifying and determining outreach organization partners to develop relationship and to better serve organization goals.
* Participates in professional development which may include positive youth development trainings, Titleist Performance Institute, U.S. Kids Golf seminars and professional golf certifications.
* Ensures goals and objectives are met in areas including customer satisfaction, safety, quality and team member performance.
* Assists in the planning of short and long\-term strategies and objectives.
* Collects, records and produces accurate and timely reports of program data.
* Manages attendance, rosters, equipment inventories and data capture related to all programming.
* Creates, maintains and manages all registration pages.
* Other tasks and duties as relevant and assigned.

 **Minimum Skills and Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s degree in related field of study and/or combination of acceptable education and relative work experience.

* Customer service approach with excellent communication and interpersonal skills; outgoing and comfortable in administering small group presentations.
* Demonstrated proficiency in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint presentations.
* Ability to work independently while also effectively interacting and collaborating with other departments and team members to achieve various organizational goals.
* Able to troubleshoot, pivot and adapt to changing situations and environments.
* Conveys a positive demeanor that is professional and approachable at all times.
* Must be able to stand for prolonged periods of time, to include bending/stooping; able to lift and move up to 25 lbs., and occasionally lift and move up to 50 lbs. with minimal assistance.

jobs.title: Purchasing and Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We're looking for a detail\-oriented, communicative, and self\-motivated individual to join our office team. This role sits at the intersection of purchasing, vendor coordination, customer communication, and production support. You'll be a key link between our shop floor, our suppliers, our outside processing vendors, and our customers — keeping jobs moving and people informed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Purchasing \& Procurement**

* Source and purchase raw materials (bar stock, plate, extrusions, etc.) based on job requirements and production schedules
* Solicit and compare quotes (RFQs) from material suppliers and select vendors based on price, lead time, and quality
* Issue and manage vendor purchase orders accurately and on time
* Receive purchase orders into the ERP system (JobBOSS), verify quantities and documentation, and flag discrepancies

**Outside Processing Coordination**

* Submit work orders to outside processing vendors (plating, heat treat, anodize, grinding, etc.)
* Actively follow up with vendors to ensure on\-time return of parts relative to job due dates
* Maintain visibility into all open outside processing jobs and escalate delays proactively
* Track and manage outside processing aging to prevent jobs from slipping

**Customer Communication**

* Provide proactive order status updates to customers via phone and email
* Respond to delivery inquiries and communicate any schedule changes clearly and professionally
* Coordinate with internal team members to gather accurate delivery information before communicating externally

**Production \& Team Support**

* Work closely with the shop floor, scheduling, and management to understand priorities and help meet production deadlines
* Assist with data entry, job tracking, and record\-keeping in ERP and project management systems
* Support the quoting team by gathering material and outside processing costs for open RFQs
* Help maintain organized files for POs, certifications, material certs, and vendor records
* Assist with accounts payable tasks such as matching vendor invoices to POs and coding for approval
* Handle incoming calls and route or respond as appropriate
* Pitch in on general office tasks as needed — this is a small team and we all wear multiple hats

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 2\+ years of experience in a purchasing, operations, or customer service role — ideally in manufacturing, machining, or a related industry
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple open tasks simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication
* Comfortable working in an ERP system for PO creation, receiving, and job tracking
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word)
* Self\-starter who doesn't need to be micromanaged — you take ownership of your work

**Preferred**

* Experience in a machine shop, job shop, or precision manufacturing environment
* Familiarity with outside processing operations (plating, anodize, heat treat, etc.)
* Experience with JobBOSS or similar job shop ERP
* Experience with Monday.com or similar operations/project management tools
* Understanding of basic manufacturing documents: travelers, certifications, inspection reports

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Pay Rate: $26\.00 – $30\.00 per hour, depending on experience
* Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Monday – Friday

Pay: $26\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Office \& Production Coordinator \| North Hollywood, CA \| Full\-Time, On\-Site**

About us

Dreamliner Construction is a licensed home remodeling company (CSLB \#1130285\) serving Los Angeles and the Inland Empire. We build kitchens, bathrooms and room additions, and more. We are growing fast and need someone to run the paperwork side of every job so our crews and sales team can keep moving.

The role

You are the engine behind every project. From the moment a job is sold until the final invoice is paid, you keep the file complete, the permits moving and the homeowner informed. This is a production\-focused office role with lots of phone and computer time.

What you will do

* Build and manage project files: contracts, change orders, invoices, permits and photos
* Prepare contracts and send them out for electronic signature, then track them until signed
* Submit and follow up on city permit applications and inspections
* Create and send invoices and record payments in QuickBooks
* Keep trackers and documents up to date in Google Sheets and Google Docs
* Call and email homeowners with project updates, scheduling and next steps
* Reach out to potential clients and follow up on leads
* Order office supplies and marketing materials (flyers, door hangers, yard signs, business cards)
* Support the owners, sales team and field crews with whatever keeps jobs on track

What you bring

* 2\+ years of office or administrative experience (construction or remodeling is a big plus)
* Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Docs and QuickBooks
* Clear, friendly communication on the phone, by email and in person
* Organized with details: you notice when a signature, date or document is missing
* Comfortable switching between phone calls and computer work all day
* Good energy, open to learning and hungry to grow
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus

What we offer

* $26/hour, full\-time (about $4,500/month)
* Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM
* Paid holidays and paid sick leave
* Performance bonus
* A clear path to Production Manager as the company grows
* Direct training from the owners

How to apply (required)

We do not hire from resumes alone. To be considered, record a short video (3 minutes max) answering the five questions below, and send the link to info@mydreamliner.com with the subject line "Office Coordinator: Your Full Name". Loom, unlisted YouTube or a Google Drive link all work. Please make sure the link is viewable.

Start your video by saying the word "Blueprint."

* Tell us about yourself and why this role at a remodeling company caught your eye.
* Describe a time you managed a lot of files, deadlines or moving pieces at once. How did you stay organized?
* Tell us about a time you handled a frustrated customer on the phone. What did you say, and how did it end?
* What is something you taught yourself recently, and how did you learn it?
* Tell us about a mistake you made at work and what you did about it.

Applications without a video will not be reviewed.

Pay: $25\.78 \- $29\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:

**The Simple Luxe Builds \| Norwalk, CA**  
**Full\-time \| In\-person \| Salary \+ performance bonus**

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
The mission of The Los Angeles Cancer Network is to provide unparalleled care to each patient that comes through our doors. We offer individualized treatment using the most recent and relevant proven advances in cancer care, curated with deliberation and compassion. LACN is committed to educating and supporting our patients and their families through every step of the way. We deliver a unique approach for every patient to ensure they receive treatment best suited to their condition, age, and other important factors. We do this by participating in important clinical research, encouraging screenings for early detection, and providing innovative treatment. We are proud to be at the forefront of cancer research through our partnership with OneOncology.


Why Join Us? We are looking for talented and highly\-motivated individuals who demonstrate a natural desire to support the meaningful work of community oncologists and the patients we serve.

**Job Description:**


The **Clinical Research Coordinator** works independently providing study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details, and participating in the informed consent process. Responsible for accurate and timely source documents, data collection, documentation, entry, and reporting including timely response to sponsor queries. Responsible for compiling and reporting on each study including information related to protocol activity, accrual data, workload, and other research information; present this information at regular research staff meetings. May plan and coordinate strategies for increasing patient enrollment, improving efficiency, training of personnel, or identifying new research opportunities. Ensures compliance with all federal and local agencies including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local Institutional Review Board (IRB).

**Essential Functions:**


The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time with reasonable accommodations.

* Independent study coordination including screening of potential patients for protocol eligibility, presenting non\-medical trial concepts and details to the patients, and participating in the informed consent process.
* Scheduling of patients for research visits and procedures.
* In collaboration with the physician and other medical personnel, documents thoroughly on Case Report Forms (CRFs) the following: changes in patient condition, adverse events, concomitant medication use, protocol compliance, response to study drug.
* Maintains accurate source documents related to all research procedures.
* Responsible for accurate and timely data collection, documentation, entry, and reporting including timely response to sponsor queries.
* Schedules and participates in monitoring and auditing activities.
* Responsible for compiling and reporting on each study including information related to protocol activity, accrual data, workload, and other research information; present this information at regular research staff meetings.
* Notifies direct supervisor about concerns regarding data quality and study conduct.
* Works closely with a regulatory coordinator or directly with the Institutional Review Board (IRB) to submit Adverse Events, Serious Adverse Events, protocol deviations, and Safety Letters in accordance with local and federal guidelines.
* May involve in assisting with patient research billing and reconciliation.
* Ensures compliance with all federal and local agencies including the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and local Institutional Review Board.
* Maintains research practices using Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.
* Maintains strict patient confidentiality according to HIPAA regulations and applicable law.
* May coordinate training and education of other personnel.
* May participate in centralized activities such as auditing, Standard Operating Procedure development, etc.
* Responsible to plan and coordinate strategies for increasing patient enrollment, and/or improving clinical research efficiency.
* May identify quality and performance improvement opportunities and collaborate with staff in the development of action plans to improve quality.
* May identify new research opportunities and present to investigators
* Participates in required training and education programs.

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong customer service background, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Knowledge of computer/telephone support, preferably in the healthcare industry.
* Ability to resolve customer issues calmly and professionally with diplomacy and tact.

**Education and Experience:**

* BA/BS Degree – Preferred.
* ACRP/SoCRA (or equivalent) certification preferred.
* 1 year minimum of clinical research coordination experience, required
* Previous Oncology/Hematology experience preferred.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Great Customer Service Skills.
* Knowledge of medical terminology, specifically in Oncology/Hematology.
* Able to travel to satellite clinics when necessary.
* Must be willing and able to lift up to 25 pounds.

**Compensation:**

* Pay range from $75k to $80k, depending on experience and education.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
We believe a story can change what a person can see: not by arguing, but by showing them something true they didn’t have words for. Dream Three is a story studio built to deliver best\-in\-class, genre\-spanning narratives across mediums, including film and series, theater and live events, publishing and music, and digital and immersive. If you’re looking for a team that takes big creative swings and doesn’t settle for less than excellent, keep reading.


ROLE OVERVIEW


We’re hiring a hands\-on freelance Social Media Manager to craft compelling content for our projects and brands. You’ll identify standout moments in existing material, develop original concepts, and shape and edit assets with a sharp eye for quality, audience behavior, and brand voice, managing each piece through approval and publication. You’ll plan original content and handle lightweight capture within the agreed scope. Dream Three sets brand direction and approval boundaries; you own the editorial proposal and day\-to\-day delivery. This is an execution\-focused individual contributor role for someone who combines creative judgment, strong craft, and dependable follow\-through.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* You establish a reliable weekly cadence by setting clear priorities, crafting review\-ready content, publishing posts on time, and organizing it all within a well\-defined workflow.
* You provide stakeholders with clear updates, realistic deadlines, and work that respects each brand’s voice and approval boundaries.
* Your content has clear hooks, accurate context, and purposeful pacing; performance findings inform the next round of work.
* You plan realistically, flag capacity constraints early, and align output with agreed capacity, material availability, and revision requirements.
* You manage routine comments and messages during agreed coverage windows, follow established response guidelines, and escalate sensitive matters as needed.


WHO YOU ARE

* You move efficiently without compromising taste, accuracy, or attention to detail.
* You welcome direct creative feedback and translate it into stronger work.
* You understand platform\-native short\-form storytelling and can explain why a moment or a treatment is effective.
* You see the edit before it’s filmed. You recognize promising hooks and turn an idea or raw material into a clear execution. You pivot quickly when content isn’t landing and recommend stronger alternatives.
* You are organized and dependable: you communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and keep approvals moving.
* You take ownership of the content process from concept or source selection through publication.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* **Editorial Planning:** Translate approved brand direction into a practical calendar and source selections, original concepts, and editorial proposals.

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice\-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Most companies that sell to developers treat events like a booth and a badge scanner. We don't. Over the past year we've shipped 35\+ events — dinners, meetups, conference activations — and the playbook works. Now we're hiring the person who runs it day to day. To be clear about the tradeoff: this is an execution\-heavy role. Venues, vendors, budgets, swag logistics, and follow\-up lists that actually reach sales within 48 hours. If you want to watch from the strategy deck, this isn't it. If you want to own real events end to end from week one — at the exact moment the team is scaling — keep reading.

jobs.title: Regional Account Manager-Print Sales
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Regional Account Manager, Commercial (RAM) is a strategic, consultative sales professional responsible for prospecting, cultivating and penetrating sales within selected (named) corporate/regional accounts. The RAM also prospects for large, strategic corporate customers that can be added into the portfolio. Following the FXO sales process, this position will identify, acquire, activate and grow FedEx Office customers. The RAM serves as the primary contact for developing long\-term customer relationships and negotiating, securing, and activating program purchase commitments at established price levels. The RAM uses business acumen to identify unique solutions from the FedEx Office (FXO) suite of products and services that match the customers’ business objectives. The portfolio's assigned customers are primarily located in North California. **Applicants should reside in Nor Cal. This is a work from home position.**

 **GENERAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**:

*(This is a representative list of the general duties the position may be asked to perform, and is not intended to be all\-inclusive)*

* Serves as a trusted advisor to the customer using a proactive, strategic approach, while developing tactical plans to drive the strategy and revenue delivery
* Achieves all sales activity standards, and revenue and performance objectives related to retention and growth of both existing and new customer prospects
* Upon identifying customer business objectives, identifies and demonstrates how FXO products and services meet customer needs
* Develop strategies to grow, enhance and maintain long\-term profitable customer relationships
* Actively partner with both Sales and Operations leadership
* Engage resources required, both corporate and field, to support sales implementation and activation efforts
* Function as liaison between customer and FXO corporate teams, plus vendor partners as needed
* Manage the entirety of assigned customers and travel when necessary to locations (with possible national travel) within the account, as required to include scheduling and conducting regular in\-person visits to new and existing customers
* Provide pricing information and pricing levels to named account base, per established pricing guidelines
* Interact with Sales leadership and support resources to develop and execute sales strategies for existing customers and new business development
* Participate in the identification and qualification of new customer prospects, and provide relevant information to be considered for the customer base
* Initiate marketing activities to activate FXO services to defined customer segments
* Ensure that customers are trained to utilize the FXO ordering and purchasing guidelines for products
* Drive target products and promotions, as directed
* Work with other sales resources in a team selling capacity to include involvement with other FedEx operating companies and secondary coverage to national customers, as assigned
* Refer project management, including outsourcing coordination, to appropriate Operations resources
* Direct, plan and assist in customer recovery as appropriate
* Build and maintain a robust and accurate pipeline of business at established standards inside of the FXO customer relationship management (CRM) tool
* Maintain accurate customer relationship management (CRM) system data, including daily activities and account updates
* Work and utilize the extensive FedEx sponsorship programs to host key clients and strengthen customer relationships
* Maximize the FedEx value delivered to each and every customer by working cross functionally within FXO, Services and the other FedEx Operating companies
* All other duties as needed or required

 **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS**:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
* 5\+ years of business\-to\-business solutions selling experience required with a focus on prospecting new customers and developing existing business relationships
* Demonstrated business math and intermediate computer skills with MS Office
* High level of experience in sales planning, sales proposals, and selling the value propositions appropriate to corporate level customers and others in the organization
* Demonstrated understanding of sales financial targets/quotas with proven successful results
* Strong conceptual selling, presentation, closing and organizational skills
* Highly self\-motivated, with a strong appetite for learning
* Articulate; uses clear, convincing and tailored communication
* Proven selling skills and knowledge of value propositions
* Recognized flexible disposition; open to coaching and feedback
* Experience within the document solutions or product offerings industry, preferred but not required
* Experience utilizing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software programs, preferred
* Presents a personal professional image
* For new hires, must meet all FedEx Office employment qualifications in force at time of hiring
* For current FedEx Office team members, must meet hiring criteria for the position and transfer requirements as outlined in the Team Member Handbook

 **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**:

* Ability to travel as required in order to meet with customers, vendors, other team members, and/or other business necessities
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to maintain attention and concentration for extended periods of time
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to read and interpret documents and instructions from customers, vendors, and other team members
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to communicate effectively with customers, vendors, and other team members
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to perform work activities requiring cooperation and instruction
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to function in a fast\-paced environment, under substantial pressure
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to work within the appropriate level of independence
* Ability, on a consistent basis, to report

jobs.title: HPC Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.


We are seeking a motivated HPC Technical Account Manager or hardware engineer with soft skills, passionate about HPC data center technologies, comfortable working with enterprise customers to provide comprehensive solutions for sophisticated installations, maintenance, and operations for a broad scope of groundbreaking products. You will be a main point of contact for our customers; assisting them with technical inquiries, debugging, and resolving their issues. As a member of our TAM team, you are a meticulous, proficient communicator who is fundamentally interested in helping our customers succeed, taking ownership in resolving issues, and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction is maintained and delivered. A significant part of the role is interacting with engineering, marketing, and support teams regularly.

**What you will be doing:**

* Work with NVIDIA enterprise customers to resolve sophisticated technical issues and customer concerns through meticulous research and reproduction for customers installing our products with a focus on next\-generation AI, and HPC server technologies.
* Own and resolve customer issues during installation, operation, maintenance or product application.
* Work with the latest hardware (e.g. GPUs, AI accelerators, high\-speed interconnects) and software technologies such as ML frameworks and tools like Spark, Kubernetes, and Ceph.
* Bring independent analysis, communication, and problem\-solving skills to improve customers' experiences.
* Be a technical resource, develop, re\-define, and document standard methodologies to share with internal teams (support / R\&D) for support processes and improvements.

**What we need to see:**

* 8\+ years in providing in\-depth customer support and debugging for hardware and software products.
* BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Profound knowledge and experience with Linux and Networking (LFCS / RHCSA)
* Expertise with data center virtualization (VMWARE, Docker, Kubernetes) concepts and trends.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to maintain and lead the overall resolution for any critical issue raised by our customers, under all circumstances.
* Superb communication and presentation/oral skills
* Strong organizational skills and able to prioritize / multi\-task easily with limited supervision.

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Experience troubleshooting, debugging, and solving problems in large\-scale HPC network environments
* Experience as a developer and/or support escalation team member for large enterprise customers or service providers.
* Scripting in Python, bash, Ansible, yaml, etc…
* Background with developing or debugging AI and data analytics software.


Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/


Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD \- 258,750 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD \- 322,000 USD for Level 5\.
You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

jobs.description:
What We Need
  
CORPAY is currently looking to hire an Account Manager within our Corpay division. This position falls under our Corpay line of business and is located in Brentwood, TN, San Mateo, CA or Beaverton, OR. In this role, you will be the primary client services contact responsible for supporting retention, client satisfaction and issue resolution of their assigned accounts. This position is responsible for assisting with all aspects of client relationships to ensure satisfaction and effective use of products and services. Account Manager is assigned a portfolio of customers and is responsible for understanding and resolving issues pertaining to products utilized by the client. A strong level of technical knowledge is needed for this position along with the ability to travel to client sites as needed. You will report directly to the hiring manager and regularly collaborate with other department/teams as needed
  
  

How We Work
  
As an Account Manager, you will be expected to work in a Hybrid environment. CORPAY will set you up for success by providing:
  
* Assigned workspace in office and home office setup
* Company\-issued equipment
* Formal, hands\-on training


Role Responsibilities
  
  

**The responsibilities of the role will include:**  

* Working directly with clients as a primary point of contact for day to day account support, problem resolution, technical clarity, research and analysis
* Responding to inbound emails, fax, and phone calls, and Salesforce cases
* Developing and executing a client service delivery strategy for assigned clients around the needs, contracts specifications and cost components
* Conducting regularly scheduled calls, presentations to review business performance, including training and education
* Making decisions regarding the set up and support of the clients assigned to their care
* Preparing and presenting solutions in advance to retain relationships
* Using customer feedback to monitor the status of service levels, identifies problems and revenue growth potential within the client base
* Effectively interacting with internal departments to support customer base
* Trouble\-shooting of client\-raised servicing issues to determine if the issue is a system issue, training issue, or client configuration.


Qualifications \& Skills
  
* Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent work experience required.
* One to two years’ work experience with customer servicing responsibility.
* Must be able to manage time effectively and work independently without direct supervision
* Excellent level of personal organization with superior telephone etiquette, verbal and written communication skills, as well as, customer service skills are required
* Ability to react quickly and decisively to resolve customer issues
* Demonstrated ability to work calmly in a fast\-paced team environment while effectively managing multiple projects
* Self\-driven to develop professionally, improve performance, and understand the tools in place and maximize their use.
* Demonstrates leadership qualities that influence peers to work collaboratively, automate manual processes, and use the systems available to their fullest potential.
* Serves as key contributor in developing and testing new processes and procedures that enhance the users experience.
* Acts as change agent as appropriate.


Benefits \& Perks
  
* Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire
* Automatic enrollment into our 401k plan (subject to eligibility requirements)
* Virtual fitness classes offered company\-wide
* Robust PTO offerings including: major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, \& volunteer time
* Employee discounts with major providers (i.e. wireless, gym, car rental, etc.)
* Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations
* Fun culture with company\-wide contests and prizes

jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

jobs.description:
As a **Territory Sales Representative**, you will work independently within an assigned territory to promote **Verizon wireless and internet solutions** to residents through apartment communities and multi\-family properties. You will build relationships with property managers and leasing teams, host on\-site events, and drive customer engagement and sales. The ideal candidate is motivated, confident, and comfortable working in the field. Strong communication, organization, and time management skills are essential. In this role, you will generate **new customer acquisitions**, strengthen property partnerships, execute community events, and achieve **sales goals** through effective **territory management** and resident outreach.

**Ready to grow your career?** If you're motivated by building relationships, achieving sales goals, and creating exceptional customer experiences, we encourage you to apply today!

* **Comprehensive Training \& Mentorship** – Receive the support, coaching, and resources needed to succeed and grow in your role.
* **Competitive Compensation** – Base hourly \+ generous commission potential.
* **Company Resources \& Mileage Reimbursement** – Access the tools and support you need to perform at your best.
* **Health Coverage Options** – Choose from a variety of plans to meet your individual and family needs.

* Develop and maintain positive relationships with property managers
* Achieve weekly and monthly sales goals, and weekly event scheduling and activation goals
* Schedule events and identify and execute additional marketing tactics
* Pre\-promote events and offers
* Establish clear communication between clients and prospects, and internal client teams
* Administrative duties include but are not limited to event recapping, finance management and product inventory
* Ideal candidates will possess prior sales experience in related fields such as outside sales, business to business, retail, brand ambassador or Telecom
* Possess a strong work ethic
* Solid organization, communication and interpersonal skills are imperative
* Reliable form of transportation (commuting/some travel is required)

jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**


The Inside Sales Associate is responsible for generating and nurturing sales opportunities through proactive outreach, relationship management, and support of the field sales team. This individual plays a key role in driving revenue growth by identifying qualified leads, managing inbound inquiries, coordinating with territory managers, and ensuring a positive customer experience throughout the sales process.


The ideal candidate is energetic, goal\-oriented, and motivated by building relationships and achieving measurable results in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment.

**Duties \& Responsibilities:**

* Conduct outbound calls, emails, and follow\-ups to generate new leads and qualify inbound inquiries.
* Research and identify potential customers within target markets.
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, activities, and opportunities within the CRM system.
* Collaborate closely with Territory Managers and the Marketing team to support campaigns and events that drive pipeline growth.
* Schedule product demonstrations, virtual meetings, and follow\-up calls for field sales representatives.
* Assist with quote generation, order processing, and ensuring timely delivery of sales materials.

* Provide exceptional service to ensure customer satisfaction and long\-term engagement.

* Support continuous improvement of sales tools, CRM processes, and outreach strategies.

**Minimum Requirements \& Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 1\-3 years of inside sales, business development, or customer service experience; experience in medical device, aesthetics, or technology industries a plus.
* Strong communication skills; confident, persuasive, and customer\-focused.
* Proficient in Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Self\-motivated with excellent organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic, high\-energy environment and meet or exceed targets.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


We’re a team that helps customers win by staying close to their needs and championing their success. We work across Micron to make customer engagement smoother, faster, and more insightful—because strong relationships fuel strong business outcomes!


In this role, you’ll support some of our largest global customers by coordinating cross‑functional actions, keeping priorities aligned, and making complex situations feel simple. You’ll guide day‑to‑day commercial activity, lead high‑stakes escalations, and deliver polished, executive‑ready communication. If you thrive in fast\-moving environments and enjoy bringing clarity to complexity, this role will feel like home.

**Responsibilities:**

* Route and qualify leads into executive\-relationship or early\-architecture motions with clear next steps
* Improve and maintain scalable operating standards, documentation, and training
* Serve as the primary contact for commercial updates, customer signals, and product offerings
* Coordinate cross\-functional escalations, track follow\-through, and deliver executive\-ready messaging
* Manage quarterly execution by balancing shipment priorities, risks, and revenue alignment

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5–8\+ years in account management, business development, or sales in semiconductor or technology
* Experience operating in complex enterprise or hyperscaler environments
* Strong executive communication skills, including clear issue and recovery narratives
* Proven ability to manage complex quoting and RFQ workflows with high accuracy
* Hands\-on experience with demand/supply alignment, commit management, and backlog dynamics
* Integrate agentic AI tools into workflow

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s or advanced degree in Business, Marketing, or related field
* Experience selling technical or hardware\-based B2B solutions
* Experience supporting hyperscale or large enterprise accounts with deep collaborator networks
* Familiarity with global fulfillment, allocation environments, and quarter\-end execution
* Experience owning customer relationships with executive\-level decision makers


The US base salary range that Micron Technology estimates it could pay for this full\-time position is:


$84,000– $113,400 a year


Additional compensation may include benefits, bonuses, and equity.


Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target base pay for new hire salaries of the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional job\-related factors, including knowledge, skills, experience, tenure and relevant education or training. The pay scale is subject to change depending on business needs. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.


As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future. We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget. Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave. Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time\-off program and paid holidays. **POSITION:** Project Coordinator  

**DEPARTMENT:** City Bar Justice Center, Federal Pro Se Legal Assistance Project – S.D.N.Y.  

**POSITION REPORTS TO:** Director, FedPro\-SDNY  

**LOCATION:** Hybrid (New York, NY)  

**FLSA STATUS**: Non\-exempt (Local 153, Office and Professional Employees International Union)  

  

The City Bar Justice Center is the largest division of the New York City Bar Association's charitable affiliate, the City Bar Fund. For nearly 50 years, our organization has furthered access to justice by addressing the unmet civil legal needs of New Yorkers facing poverty and other systemic socioeconomic barriers. The Justice Center mobilizes law firms, corporate legal departments, and other legal institutions to provide pro bono legal services; educates the public on legal issues; fosters community relationships; and shapes public policy. Its civil justice projects deliver high\-quality services through brief advice, referrals, and direct representation. Last year, more than 3,300 pro bono attorneys partnered with the Justice Center to provide free legal services to over 23,000 New Yorkers who could not afford private counsel.  

  

**PROGRAM FUNCTION**  

FedPro\-SDNY is an innovative initiative providing free, limited\-scope legal assistance to “pro se” individuals – i.e., those representing themselves, including incarcerated individuals – while litigating civil cases in the Southern District, mostly in the areas of civil and prisoner rights, employment discrimination, contracts/warranties, and consumer/finance matters, and a range of other claims touching on core individual rights and the protection of livelihoods. Working closely with a tight\-knit FedPro\-SDNY team, project coordinators actively assist with litigant intake and case management, help to determine which litigants can be helped by the Project, and liaise with law student interns, volunteer attorneys and a social work team to support litigants served by FedPro\-SDNY.  

  

**JOB FUNCTION**  

The City Bar Justice Center (CBJC) seeks an enthusiastic and organized individual to join the three\-person project coordinator team with our Federal Pro Se Legal Assistance Project operating in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York (FedPro\-SDNY). One project coordinator (similar to paralegal) position is available now for a candidate committed to expanding access to justice.  

  

**This role works closely with and under the supervision of the FedPro\-SDNY Director to handle the following areas of responsibility, among others:*** Serve as the first point of contact for pro se litigants seeking legal assistance, including interviewing and screening litigants for eligibility for FedPro\-SDNY services by phone, email, and/or in person at FedPro\-SDNY’s lower Manhattan courthouse office, while providing caring follow\-up to the pro se litigants, who typically seek our assistance at vulnerable moments in their lives.
* Carefully maintain case, program/activity, and volunteer records and databases, and run and analyze statistical and other reports.
* Provide administrative help by helping to engage interns and volunteers, and organizing virtual and in\-person training programs, events, and legal clinics.
* Liaise with attorney volunteers from large firms, corporate legal departments, and solo practices.
* Assist in preparing grant applications and reports, and in designing and writing program content such as blogs, reports, legal informational resources, presentations and social media posts.
* As needed, provide general administrative support, including with new FedPro\-SDNY programming and with other CBJC projects.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS*** Bachelor’s degree or substantially equivalent work experience in a professional setting.
* Minimum 6 months of work experience (relevant internships acceptable).
* Strong data entry, organizational and project management skills; high attention to detail; excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable communicating both by telephone and in direct contact with the public; self\-starter with a record showing (or a demonstrable capacity for) consistent professional timeliness and reliability.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, and the ability to quickly learn and effectively use LegalServer and other technology.
* A curiosity to learn about various federal laws and civil litigation procedure.
* A team player with an ability to interact respectfully with people of different backgrounds and perspectives on the justice system, including litigants, fellow staff members, volunteer attorneys, and court staff and other government employees, and desire and capacity to engage with members of the public in a respectful and sensitive way, many of whom suspect institutions and the legal profession, and some of whom experience legal problems compounded by mental health struggles.
* Demonstrated enthusiasm for public interest legal work, serving those who struggle with a lack of resources, and providing legal assistance to historically underserved communities.
* Professional working proficiency in Spanish or another non\-English language a plus but not required.

*Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor visas for this position.*  

  

We are looking for a candidate for this currently open position who is willing to make a minimum commitment of two years to the Project Coordinator role. This is a hybrid position for which candidates must be available for 2\-3 in\-person workdays during standard business hours, primarily at FedPro\-SDNY’s downtown Manhattan courthouse, with the balance of time split between work\-from\-home, work at CBJC’s main offices in midtown Manhattan for supervision, team, and committee meetings, and occasional other local work\-related travel.

The CUNY Fatherhood Academy (CFA) is a comprehensive program designed to promote responsible parenting and to foster economic stability for unemployed and underemployed young fathers through education, employment, and personal development. Increased familial engagement, attaining a High School Equivalency (HSE) diploma and finding gainful employment are all essential goals of the CFA.


The program’s central focus is to help young fathers prepare for and enroll into college or training programs, with the understanding that earning a college degree is the most effective path toward providing long\-term economic sustainability for themselves and their families. The program is targeted to serve fathers and expectant fathers, ages 18–30, throughout New York City.

* Maintains a caseload of active and alumni participants. Provides individual and group counseling, coaching, mentoring, and career exploration support.

You will work closely with the JPMorganChase Origination Businesses, ensuring all required documents, reference data, and critical information are reviewed for operational feasibility, optimal execution mechanics, regulatory requirements and mitigation of operational risk.


The Wholesale Lending Services team partners with various internal and external parties including, but not limited to, Debt Capital Markets, Credit Risk, Loan and Agency Services, Product Control, Legal, Trade Settlements, as well as JPM Borrowers and Lender Clients. The team also interacts with their international counterparts in Europe and the Asia Pacific on cross\-border deals originating out of North America.

* Assign, Manage, and maintain Investment and Commercial Bank transaction pipeline.
* Ensure a broad understanding of the loan products, and the overall industry in order to effectively assist the junior analysts on the team, acting as the point of escalation.
* Collect and review legal loan documentation for operational feasibility, optimal execution mechanics, regulatory requirements and mitigation of operational risk.
* Coordinate and review of internal closing documentation with Debt Capital Markets, Credit Risk, Loan and Agency Services, Product Control, Legal, Trade Settlements, as well as Borrowers and Lenders.
* Discuss and advise funding mechanics and operational requirements as it pertains to internal booking locations, regional, and currency policies.

Through various programs and events, it fosters engagement among architects, professionals, and the public. Both AIA New York and the Center for Architecture advocate for the importance of design in enhancing urban life. They prioritize values such as civic engagement, equity, environmental sustainability, resiliency, technological innovation, and inspiring design.

**Job Summary:** 

The Events \& Administrative Coordinator is responsible for managing the Center’s calendar, overseeing the execution of internal events and third\-party rentals that occur at the Center, managing the organization’s Board meetings, and some office administration. Reporting to the Director of Finance and Operations, the Events \& Administrative Coordinator works closely with the Executive Director, Membership Team, A/V Team, Facilities team, and other personnel as required. Daily responsibilities are both administrative and operational. The Events \& Administrative Coordinator is an energetic professional who doesn't mind wearing multiple hats. Experienced in handling a wide range of administrative duties and executive support\-related tasks and able to work independently with little or no supervision. Well organized, flexible, and enjoys the challenges of supporting an office of diverse people.

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

*Calendar, Space, and Operations Management (30%):*

· Manage the CFA’s master calendar of space bookings, coordinating across all departments to ensure up to date.

· Serves as main point of contact and maintains institutional knowledge of all events, meetings, exhibitions, and other programs that happen at the Center.

· Supports the organizations to ensure the registration process for each event runs efficiently.

· Schedule, train, and supervise part\-time CFA Front Desk staff, and ensure they are completing daily tasks and special projects.

· Some office administration tasks, including but not limited to: distributing mail, maintenance of office equipment, ordering supplies with reference to organizational budget.

· With Director of Finance \& Operations, oversee daily operations of office equipment, including photocopier and postage meter, etc.

*Executive Director/Board/Senior Management Support (10%):*

· Manage the Executive Director’s calendar and daily schedule and ensure that the Executive Director and his office are prepared for meetings.

· Book travel, lodging, and meal reservations for Executive Director, senior management, and Board members as needed.

· Manages Executive Director’s American Express monthly reports.

· Some email and phone correspondence on behalf of the Executive Director is required, mainly in the areas of scheduling meetings, meeting follow\-up tasks, and logistical inquiries.

· Lead the scheduling, follow\-up, and execution of all meeting invites in both office calendar and in Zoom meeting rooms.

· Coordinate scheduling and prep work for AIANY and CFA Board meetings, including the dissemination of materials and information required by Board members to participate in said meetings.

· Creates and maintains up\-to\-date board lists, maintains working knowledge of Board members.

· Responsible for the creation and distribution of agendas and supplemental materials for all Board meetings \& select Committee meetings (approximately 25 per year, virtual/hybrid/ onsite).

· Attends all Board meetings to take minutes.

· Drives the creation of annual Board binders, liaises with appropriate staff members to collect information needed.

*Event Operations and Rental Business Development (60%):*

· Work closely with the A/V Manager, Membership Team, Facilities Manager, and Director of Finance \& Operations to ensure that staff and resources are properly planned for events.

* Schedule catering, beverage service, floor plans for internal programs and events taking place in the Center.

· Manage events on\-site, assisting with set up, as needed.

· Manage inquiries, sales pipeline, and billing for event space rental clients.

· Ascertain space and run of show information from clients, coordinate physical set up with facilities staff, communicate and book appropriate A/V support, and serve as staff host for rental events.

· Responsible for budgeting and cash flow of space rentals, reporting information to Director of Finance \& Operations.

**Education and Experience:**

· Bachelor’s Degree

· 2\-3 years’ work experience in an office management or administrative role.

· Excellent computer skills, particularly with Microsoft Office . Experience with Salesforce is a plus.

· A proven track record of supporting senior management and organizational leaders.

· Ability to manage multiple schedules, including predicting the needs of leaders and meeting/event attendees for various appointments.

· Solid interpersonal communication skills, organizational skills, and attention to detail, paired with persistent follow\-through.

· Ability to multi\-task. This means you are able to receive many incoming tasks and requests, prioritize them, and effectively complete them.

· Ability to have some flexibility in work schedule, with some evening and weekend work required.

· Office coordination, particularly within the events industry and /or a cultural or nonprofit institution

**Additional Information**

Location: This is a predominantly in person role, with some remote work possible (up to approx. 2 days per week, depending on event and programmatic need

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Sales Coordinator**


**JOB TITLE: Sales Coordinator**


**REPORTS TO:** Director of Sales \& Marketing


**Purpose for the Position:** To act as personal support for the Sales Department. To detail all incoming functions, maintain room block inventories, and qualify all incoming sales calls.


**Essential Responsibilities:**


* Performs general duties including typing, dictation and answering the telephone.
* Audits Sales System (STS, Delphi, Ci/Ty, eta) for accuracy, space conflicts and space control on behalf of the department director.
* Manage rooming list according to clients' requests and the Sales Manager's direction.
* Processes all paper flow in and out of Sales management offices.
* Maintains a filing system of reports and pertinent records.
* Answers/forwards client requests, complaints or questions in a courteous, timely manner.
* Receives, opens and sorts all sales department mail daily.
* Sends and receives faxes.
* Makes photocopies.
* Monitors and inventories all office supplies.
* Orders supplies as approved by the Sales Department.
* Attends sales meetings. Types and distributes minutes.
* Assists administrative office staff during periods of absence.
* Contacts managerial and staff personnel for collection of dates, statistics, and reports. Performs follow\-up reports or special assignments.
* May compose replies to correspondence based on organizational practice, policies, and procedures at the direction of the Department head.
* May assign and distribute work under general direction to other clerical and office associates.
* Completes projects as determined by the Department head.

**To do this kind of work, you must be able to:**


* Provides professional and courteous guest service at all times.
* Understand the principles relating to the product you are selling.
* Organize your own activities to make the best use of your time.
* Express yourself well when talking to potential buyers and sellers, discuss features of the products and services involved and convince the other person of both your knowledge and integrity.
* Use arithmetic in computing the cost of sale to the customer.
* Maintain enthusiasm and interest throughout all conferences with buyers and sellers.
* Keep accurate records of contacts, sales, and purchases.
* Be available on nights, weekends, and holidays.

**Physical Demands:** Lifting up to 20 lbs. Maximum with frequent lifting and/or carrying of objects weighing up to 10lbs. Requires walking or standing to a significant degree, reaching, handling, feeling, talking, hearing, seeing.


**Environmental Conditions:** Inside: Protection from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes. A job is considered “inside” if the worker spends approximately 75% or more of the time inside.


**Math Skills:** Requires mathematical development sufficient to be able to: add, subtract, multiply, and divide all units of measure.


**Language Skills:** Must have developed language skills to the point to be able to: Read newspapers, periodicals, journals, and manuals. Write business letters, summaries and reports using prescribed format and conforming to all rules of punctuation, grammar, diction and style. Participate in discussions and debates. Speak extemporaneously on a variety of subjects.


**Relationships to Data, People and Things:**


**Data:** Coordinating: Determining time, place, and sequence of operations or action to be taken on the basis of analysis of data; executing determination and/or reporting on events.


**People:** Persuading: Influencing others in favor of a product or service or point of view.


**Things:** Handling: Using body members, hand tools, and/or special devices to work, move, or carry objects or materials. Involves little or no latitude for judgment with regard to attainment of standards or in selecting appropriate tools, objects or materials.


**Specific Vocational Preparation:** On the job training or essential experience in less responsible jobs over 1 year and including 2 years; Associates or Bachelor’s degree helpful.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview : PRG is the world’s leading technology provider within the entertainment and events industry. Our mission is to bring together the power of our people with our production and rental expertise to deliver unforgettable events. PRG has the largest inventory of production equipment for hire and offers a complete 360\-degree range of services to clients within the live events industry. These include music touring and festivals, TV \& Film, Theatre, Sports and E\-sports and Corporate live events. Our clients and partners rely on PRG’s innovation, experience and in\-depth expertise in video, lighting, rigging, staging, virtual productions, and set \& automation systems to bring their creative visions to life. With 38 offices located in North America, South America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia and Australia, PRG offers the ability to provide services worldwide by collaborating with our local partners. Responsibilities:

The **Production Coordinator’s** primary responsibility is to support the Production Management group with the planning, budgeting, and execution of events and/or entertainment projects in all markets and facets PRG serves.

  

* They will support both on\-site and off\-site project efforts through the planning and delivery of the appropriate services, equipment and support.
* Assisting Production Management group with the creation of budget documents for new proposals,
* Gathering of quotes from third party vendors, and providing support to the PM/AM through the execution of a project. It is the policy of PRG to provide excellent customer service both internally and externally.
* Employees are expected to perform all of their duties and responsibilities in accordance with this policy at all times.
* Does related work as required.
* The Production Coordinator is responsible for supporting Production Managers with maintaining established event schedule, scope, and budget.

**Essential Functions:*** Open job numbers
* Create Purchase Orders
* Review submitted documents and requests for accuracy and compliance
* Asist in obtaining pre\-payments
* Help in troubleshooting issues with PO’s, invoices, payments for jobs for all projects
* Schedule or run job reports for Production Managers
* Assist Production Managers with project closeout
* Help in reconciliation of projects
* Responsible for processing of invoices, POs, and job number creation in conjunction with the accounting team.
* Track and update production labor submissions.
* Ensure receipt of signed contracts and official forms required for project execution i.e. proof of insurance, tax forms, and change order agreements.

  


Qualifications:
* High School Diploma or equivalency required.
* Microsoft Word and Excel proficiency is required.
* Completion of two years of post\-secondary education from an accredited institution of higher learning with a concentration in business administration, hospitality management, operations management or related entertainment technology fields. Or equivalent amount of production related experience.
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in project coordination within the entertainment market or equivalent experience in shop or show site operations.
* Strong communication and customer service skills.
* Former PRG internship experience a plus
* Time management skills
* Ability to handle multiple projects at once.


EEO and Disclosure:
***The pay range for this position is estimated to be $75,000\.00\-100,000\.00\. Actual pay to be determined by the experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant combined with location and alignment with market data. Additionally, we offer comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching contributions.***

 *PRG is an Equal Opportunity Employer. PRG is a drug\-free work environment, pre\-employment testing will be required.*

 *This is a safety sensitive position and will require pre\-employment drug screening.*

 *Production Resource Group LLC participates in E\-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I\-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.*

 *PRG cares about the safety of our employees and applicants. PRG does not use chat rooms for job searches or communications. PRG will never request personal information via informal chat platforms or unsecure email. PRG will never ask for money or an exchange of money, banking or other personal information prior to an in\-person interview. Be aware of potential scams while job seeking. For information on job scams, visit,* *https://www.consumer.ftc.gov/JobScams* *or file a complaint at* *https://www.ftccomplaintassistant.gov/**.*
