**Who we are**
--------------


Puig is a home of Love Brands within a family company that furthers wellness, confidence and self\-expression while leaving a better world. For more than a century, our entrepreneurial spirit and passion for creativity have made us a challenger in the premium beauty industry.


With 17 Love Brands across Fragrance and Fashion, Makeup and Skincare, we create stories that connect with people’s emotions and are powered by a global team of over 13,000 passionate professionals. With products sold in more than 150 countries and €5,042 million in net revenue in 2025, and guided by strong values and sustainability commitments, Puig continues to grow as a Home of Creativity: an open\-minded space where Creators Of All Kinds are empowered to thrive, innovate and express who they are.


**The Opportunity**
-------------------


At Puig, we create desirable brands that spark emotion and shape culture. As a Media Coordinator, Prestige Marketing, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the execution and operational excellence of integrated media campaigns across our prestige fragrance portfolio, including Carolina Herrera, Rabanne, and Jean Paul Gaultier.


Reporting to the Senior Manager, Media \& Advocacy, you will partner closely with cross\-functional teams, agency partners, creators, retailers, and media networks to ensure campaigns are executed seamlessly from briefing through reporting. This is an exciting opportunity for an organized, curious, and digitally savvy marketing professional seeking to build a career at the intersection of luxury marketing, media, creator engagement, and consumer experience.


**What you'll get to do**
-------------------------


* Join a collaborative team of media and advocacy professionals, reporting to the Senior Manager, Media \& Advocacy
* Partner cross\-functionally with Brand Marketing, PR, Influencer, E\-Retail, DTC, and Creative teams to support integrated campaign planning and execution
* Assist in the development and coordination of national media, retail media, and creator marketing campaign briefs, ensuring strategic alignment across internal and external partners
* Manage and organize campaign creative assets, ensuring timely delivery and consistency across media channels and partner platforms. Coordinate asset updates and revisions with external agencies, vendors, and creative partners while maintaining alignment on brand standards and campaign objectives
* Support campaign reporting by transforming performance data and media metrics into polished presentations and actionable insights for local and international stakeholders
* Manage workflows and logistics related to influencer, advocate, agency, and vendor activations, ensuring flawless execution and delivery timelines
* Provide on\-site support for brand events, media activations, creator experiences, and VIP engagements
* Help streamline team operations through the development of efficient workflows, task management processes, meeting recaps, and follow\-up tracking to improve collaboration and accountability
* Support budget management activities, including purchase orders, invoice processing, financial reconciliation, and campaign budget tracking
* Monitor industry trends across media, luxury beauty, digital platforms, and creator partnerships to help inform future opportunities and best practices
**We'd love to meet you if you have**
-------------------------------------


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Digital Media, Communications, or a related discipline

* Strong interest in media, creator marketing, luxury brands, emerging digital platforms, and consumer engagement
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment
* Strong attention to detail, project management capabilities, and a proactive, solution\-oriented mindset
* Comfort working with campaign reporting, presentations, and performance data
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to build relationships across diverse stakeholder groups
* Fluency in Spanish or French is a plus
  

We welcome Creators Of All Kinds. If you are unsure of meeting all the requirements but trust you have the transferable skills to excel in this role, complete the application and our teams will get in touch if you are selected for an interview.

As required by New York State’s salary transparency law, effective November 2022, the expected base salary for this position ranges from **$70,000\.00 \- $75,000\.00**. iHeartMedia  



Current employees and contingent workers click here **to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.**

  



The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it! iHeartMedia, **the number one audio company in America**, reaches 90% of Americans every month \- a monthly audience that’s **twice the size of any other audio company** – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad\-supported music streaming service. In fact, we have:

* **More \#1 rated markets** than the next two largest radio companies combined;
* **We’re the largest podcast publisher**, with more monthly downloads than the second\- and third\-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest\-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;
* iHeart is **the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on\-air personalities and podcast influencers**, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;
* We create and produce some of **the most popular and well\-known branded live music events** in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;
* iHeartRadio is the **\#1 streaming radio digital service** in America;
* Our **social media footprint** is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and
* We have **the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio**, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale. As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option.


Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity. Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.


Only one company in America has the \#1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!


If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

  



**What We Need:**


We’re looking for a Sales Coordinator to support our sales team in delivering exceptional client service. You’ll help manage the pre\- and post\-sale process, coordinate campaign execution across platforms, and ensure everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, collaborative, and thrives in a fast\-paced environment.  



**What You'll Do:**

* Responsible for understanding and supporting the sales process/procedures used by iHeartMedia Sales teams
* Enter and revise orders
* Submit special billing requests
* Work with Account Executives to generate proposals
* Respond to Account Executive requests regarding spot times
* Assist the sales team with sales material creation \& recaps

  



**What You'll Need:**

* Previous experience in a sales support or operational support role
* Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize and multitask in a fast\-paced environment
* Technical aptitude with knowledge of Salesforce, and Veritone a plus
* Experience with the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Outlook, Word)
* A great attitude, flexibility, and creativity!
* An understanding of media sales or strong desire to learn about media sales
* Bi\-lingual in English and Spanish is a plus
  



**What You'll Bring:**

* Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
* Full proficiency and understanding of job function
* Open communication with colleagues and direct reports that encourages collaboration and team consensus
* Strong problem solving skills
* Efficiency with independent work under minimal guidance
* Commitment to process improvement for overall team effectiveness
* Professional communication that stresses diplomacy, empathy and patience

 **Compensation:**

  

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to relevant experience, knowledge, skills, other job\-related qualifications, and alignment with market data.

  

$17\.30 \- $21\.63

  



**Location:**


New York, NY: 125 West 55th Street, 10019  



**Position Type:**


Regular  



**Time Type:**


Full time  



**Pay Type:**


Hourly  



**Benefits:**


iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

* Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options
* Company provided and supplemental life insurance
* Paid vacation and sick time
* Paid company holidays
* A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community
* A 401K plan
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well\-being, family and caregiving
* A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

  



We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

As a Client Account Manager within Asset Management you will be responsible for delivering exceptional client experience to clients investing in Alternative strategies of J.P. Morgan Asset Management. In this role you will work in partnership with multiple stakeholders at varying levels of the organization to form a dedicated service team for each assigned client.


**Job Responsibilities**

* Coordinate onboarding and servicing with clients and 3rd parties, fielding inquiries, researching requests, and coordinating appropriate responses.
* Understand client relationship with JPM including global relationships and client's relationships with other asset managers and consultants.
* Proactively identify client experience improvements and efficiencies and driving the plan to implement changes.
* Participate in client meetings and events as appropriate (including due diligence meetings).
* Plan and organize internal business meetings and manage follow\-up/action items.
* Support the creation and management of team policies and procedures as well as templates and outline data requirements for MIS/KPI reporting.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Undergraduate degree required.
* Previous experience at an asset management firm; background in client service and/or institutional client base.
* Business acumen for financial concepts, ability to speak intelligently and confidently while using applied financial reasoning.
* Ability to develop strong client and internal relationships and an in\-depth understanding of client servicing needs.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects across business areas to achieve results.
* Highly attentive, ability to focus, excellent follow\-through, flexibility and stellar grammar and English skills.
* Strong critical thinking skills – i.e. ability to analyze, synthesize and interpret data, etc.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Series 7 and Series 63

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
We offer a competitive total rewards package including base salary determined based on the role, experience, skill set and location. Those in eligible roles may receive commission\-based pay and/or discretionary incentive compensation, paid in the form of cash and/or forfeitable equity, awarded in recognition of individual achievements and contributions. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs, based on eligibility. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, on\-site health and wellness centers, a retirement savings plan, backup childcare, tuition reimbursement, mental health support, financial coaching and more. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process.


We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.


JPMorgan Chase \& Co. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including Disability/Veterans

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

J.P. Morgan Asset \& Wealth Management delivers industry\-leading investment management and private banking solutions. Asset Management provides individuals, advisors and institutions with strategies and expertise that span the full spectrum of asset classes through our global network of investment professionals. Wealth Management helps individuals, families and foundations take a more intentional approach to their wealth or finances to better define, focus and realize their goals.

This role is based out in New Jersey and New York.

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase within the Corporate Technology, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Create innovative technology solutions to support the Client Onboarding and KYC business. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.
* Design, develop, test, and maintain high\-quality software and new product capabilities
* Collaborate with cross\-functional partners to deliver outcomes aligned to business needs
* Communicate development progress, risks, and dependencies to the team and key stakeholders
* Apply Agile practices to support iterative delivery and continuous improvement
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support reliable builds and deployments
* Use sound object\-oriented design and common design patterns to create scalable solutions
* Produce clear technical documentation and support knowledge sharing across the team
* Contribute to code quality through reviews, testing practices, and defect resolution

* Drive team adoption of enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted engineering practices to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes while establishing consistent validation standards and promoting reuse of effective patterns
* Apply SDLC toolchain knowledge, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to increase the value realized through automation




**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5\+ years applied experience
* Proficiency in Java development with J2EE server technologies (Web Services, Spring, ORM frameworks, XML, Enterprise Java Beans, JMS)
* Working knowledge of CI/CD and build tooling (such as Jenkins, TeamCity, Maven)
* Working knowledge of design patterns, UML, and object\-oriented concepts
* Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL
* Working knowledge of source control management tools (Bitbucket or equivalent)
* Working knowledge of UI technologies including HTML5 and JavaScript
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI\-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) and setting team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
* Ability to collaborate within a team and build effective working relationships
* Ability to organize work, manage priorities, and deliver to tight deadlines

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

JPMorganChase AI Research (AIR) is a global team of research scientists, engineers and product managers that develops novel AI capabilities and partners across the firm to translate breakthrough AI/ML techniques into deployed solutions. The team brings together researchers across multi\-agent systems, foundation model training, reinforcement and continual learning, multimodal document AI, formal reasoning, planning and verification, and synthetic data generation – alongside experts in trustworthy AI, privacy, and cryptography – to solve hard problems end\-to\-end in ways that are secure, reliable, and scalable in financial services.


AI Research sits within the Chief Data \& Analytics Office (CDAO) at JPMorganChase which is responsible for accelerating the firm's data and analytics journey. This includes ensuring the quality, integrity, and security of the firm's data, as well as leveraging this data to generate insights and drive decision\-making. The CDAO is also responsible for developing and implementing solutions that support the firm's commercial goals by harnessing artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to develop new products, improve productivity, and enhance risk management, effectively and responsibly.


As Business Operations Lead, VP/ED, supporting AI Research, you will be the strategic operating partner to the leadership of one of the most ambitious AI research organizations in financial services. You will shape how the team plans, invests, executes, and scales – aligning talent, capital, and infrastructure behind a bold research agenda. This is a rare seat at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI, executive strategy, and enterprise execution – ideal for a leader who thrives on turning ambiguity into structure and enabling brilliant people to do their best work.




**Job responsibilities**

* Serve as the strategic operating partner and chief of staff to the Head of AI Research, driving execution of the team's strategy and long\-term roadmap.
* Orchestrate executive management reviews, leadership offsites, and deep\-dive sessions – shaping the agenda, framing key decisions, and driving follow\-through on outcomes.
* Lead portfolio strategy and governance: intake and prioritization of research and line of business initiatives against the highest\-value opportunities across the firm.
* Own executive reporting and narrative development – communicating progress, impact, and strategic direction to senior stakeholders across CDAO and the lines of business.
* Steward the financial resources of the team to enable innovation and implementation in a fiscally responsible way – partnering with finance on multi\-year planning, headcount strategy, and disciplined allocation across talent, compute, and external commitments.
* Shape the team's presence at flagship, signature AI/ML conferences – setting a coherent external engagement strategy that elevates the firm's research brand and talent pipeline.
* Partner with analytical, data, and infrastructure platform teams to unlock the capabilities researchers need – compute, models, tooling, and data – and ensure AI Research's priorities are represented in enterprise platform roadmaps.
* Champion responsible AI governance and a balanced application of controls – enabling the team to move fast, take smart risks, and innovate within a strong risk and compliance posture.
* Aid the talent strategy and operating fabric of the team – hiring, onboarding, workplace, and culture initiatives that make AI Research a destination for the best researchers in the world.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5\+ years of business operations, COO, chief\-of\-staff, or strategy leadership experience – ideally supporting a research, technology, or highly technical organization.
* Track record as a trusted advisor to senior executives, translating vision into operating plans and driving cross\-functional execution.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen – multi\-year planning, resource allocation, and stewarding investment in innovation.
* Portfolio and prioritization instincts – able to focus a talented team on the highest\-impact work amid many competing demands.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; produces crisp executive narratives, board\-ready materials, and clear strategic updates.
* Sound judgment on risk, controls, and governance – with the instinct to balance speed of innovation with responsible execution.
* Highly organized, detail\-aware, and outcome\-driven, with a bias to action and calm under ambiguity.
* Collaborative operator who builds trust and influence across research, engineering, product, legal, finance, and business partners.
* Genuine curiosity about AI/ML and a passion for the mission of applying frontier research to real\-world financial services problems.
* Energized by enabling others – you take pride in making a world\-class team even more effective.




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Familiarity with AI/ML research workflows, top\-tier academic conferences, and the publication and IP lifecycle.
* Exposure to technology and infrastructure investment decisions (e.g., compute/cloud economics, platform prioritization, model governance).

jobs.title: Social Media Manager, Organic & Content
jobs.description:
Social Media Manager, Organic \& Content


Location: Austin, TX or New York, NY / Hybrid  

Employment: Full\-time  

Reports to: CMO of Nood, Co\-Founder/CMO of Tempo


The Opportunity
Nood is a high\-growth beauty\-tech brand making at\-home hair removal more accessible, with an expanding roadmap of devices and skincare. We’re hiring a Social Media Manager to turn our products, customer experiences, and brand point of view into content people want to watch, share, and come back for.


You’ll own Nood’s organic social presence across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok—from strategy and ideation through shooting, editing, publishing, and performance analysis. You’re a creator first: someone who understands why a video works and can bring an idea to life with a phone, a laptop, and good judgment.


You’ll also support brand incubations under the Nood umbrella, like Tempo, our recently launched wellness and supplement brand. Nood’s Co\-Founder/CMO and the relevant brand’s CEO will align on priorities and capacity.


What You’ll Own* Organic Social Strategy. Own content pillars, channel plans, and publishing calendars for Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, tied to product priorities, audience needs, and targets for follower growth, views, engagement, and site traffic.
* Hands\-On Content Creation. Concept, shoot, edit, write, and publish short\-form videos, Reels, Stories, carousels, and other relevant formats. Produce the majority of day\-to\-day content yourself, bringing in teammates and other participants when they strengthen the story.
* Brand Voice \& Storytelling. Turn product education, real routines, customer questions, and cultural moments into distinctive content. Keep Nood recognizable while adapting execution to each platform.
* Creative Testing. Test hooks, formats, pacing, and recurring series. Spot relevant trends early, improve content using results, and carry winning ideas across brands.
* Audience Engagement. Manage comments, mentions, and DMs in each brand's voice; join relevant conversations and feature customers in recurring content. Route service issues to Customer Experience and turn recurring questions into content ideas.
* Content Collaboration. Partner with the Creator Partnerships \& Community Lead on content needs and publish approved creator assets. Work with Performance Creative and Paid Media to turn organic winners into ads, share audience insights, and bring paid learnings back into organic.
* Performance \& Reporting. Own social dashboards and report weekly on reach, retention, shares, saves, audience growth, and site traffic against targets. Explain what worked, what didn’t, and what you’ll change.
* Selective Portfolio Support. Help Tempo and future brands establish their social voice, test content, and support launches within agreed priorities. Document a repeatable playbook for a new brand’s first 90 days on social.


What This Role Is About
This is a hands\-on individual contributor role with ownership of both strategy and execution. Some days you’ll be filming a product demonstration. Others, you’ll be testing a new series or digging into why one video held attention and another didn’t.


Who You Are* You’re a creator and a doer who can take an idea from concept to published content.
* You have strong taste and know how to make content feel natural to each platform.
* You use audience feedback and data to sharpen your creative judgment.
* You’re organized, self\-directed, and comfortable producing consistently in a lean team.
* You collaborate well and communicate clearly when priorities compete.
* You balance creative speed with brand standards and approved product claims.


What Success Looks Like in Your First 90 Days* A clear social strategy and sustainable publishing cadence.
* A consistent flow of original content, with promising recurring formats.
* A reliable audience engagement and customer\-service handoff process.
* Simple reporting that connects performance to creative decisions.
* A focused plan for supporting Tempo alongside the brand's priorities.

  

**Requirements**  

* 3\+ years creating content and growing social accounts for consumer brands, or equivalent results building your own audience.
* A portfolio showing strong short\-form video skills and measurable results on Instagram and TikTok.
* Experience managing brand publishing across Meta platforms, including Facebook.
* Strong shooting, editing, copywriting, and basic production skills; comfortable with CapCut, Premiere, or similar tools.
* Ability to interpret content performance and translate it into practical decisions.
* Comfortable appearing on camera or directing others.
* Able to work in person regularly in Austin or New York for collaboration and content production.


Nice to have: beauty, skincare, or wellness experience; photography and design skills; paid social creative experience; or experience launching a new social account.

 **Benefits**  

Working draft for internal review: Proposed annual base salary of $90,000–$115,000, depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities. Final range, benefits, and any incentive compensation to be confirmed before posting.

We are looking for a confident, energetic, and responsible **Luxury Livestream Sales Host** to join our team.

In this role, you will host live online selling sessions featuring a wide range of luxury products, including **designer handbags, jewelry, clothing, shoes, accessories, and more**. You will introduce products, engage with viewers, answer questions, and help drive sales during livestreams.

Compensation

This position offers a **base salary/hourly pay plus commission**.

In addition to base pay, you can earn approximately **1%–3% commission on total livestream sales across all product categories**, depending on performance and compensation structure.

Strong\-performing hosts have significant earning potential based on sales volume.

Responsibilities

* Host livestream selling sessions for luxury handbags, jewelry, apparel, shoes, accessories, and other designer products
* Present products clearly, confidently, and professionally
* Explain product details, condition, features, and selling points
* Engage with customers and answer questions during livestreams
* Create an energetic and welcoming shopping environment
* Build relationships with repeat customers and viewers
* Work closely with the sales and operations team

Qualifications

However, luxury experience is **not required**. We are also open to candidates who are:

* Responsible and dependable
* Patient and detail\-oriented
* Comfortable speaking and presenting on camera
* Motivated to learn about luxury products
* Friendly, confident, and customer\-focused
* Professional in appearance and presentation

**Fluent English is required.**

Previous experience in livestreaming, sales, retail, social media, hosting, or customer service is a plus.

Schedule

This is primarily a **full\-time position**.

Full\-time team members are expected to:

* Work at least **5 days per week**
* Work at least **8 hours per day**
* Be available for a consistent livestream schedule

Some schedule flexibility may be required depending on livestream and business needs.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys luxury fashion, feels comfortable being on camera, communicates naturally with customers, and is motivated by a performance\-based compensation structure.

If you are passionate about sales, luxury products, and livestreaming, we would love to hear from you.

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.
  

  

By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

jobs.title: Retail Sales Representative
jobs.description:
South River USA LLC

Location: New York, NY

Job Type:Full\-Time / 30–40 hours per week

Compensation: $20 \- $23/hour \+ Commission

Start Date: As soon as possible

**About South River USA**

South River USA LLC is the U.S. operating platform of Singapore\-based South River Group (SRG), an investment and brand management company focused on building, scaling, and globalizing premium consumer brands. South River USA develops and grows two distinctive tea brands: Royal Cathay, a heritage premium tea brand, and Origin Leaf, a single\-origin organic tea brand from Georgia. We are expanding these brands across specialty retail, premium grocery, hospitality, corporate gifting, e\-commerce, wholesale, and distribution partnerships.

**About the Role**

We are looking for energetic, personable, and driven Retail Sales Representatives (RSRs) to join our New York sales team. This is an outside sales and business development role focused on building physical distribution and establishing our premium tea brands with retail and hospitality businesses. You will spend significant time in the field visiting prospective accounts, introducing our products, providing samples, building relationships with decision\-makers, and converting opportunities into new accounts. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys being out in the market, meeting business owners and buyers, making cold calls, and turning relationships into sales.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prospect and develop new retail, grocery, hospitality, food service, and other B2B accounts throughout New York.
* Conduct in\-person visits and cold outreach to prospective accounts.
* Introduce and effectively communicate the story, positioning, and value of Royal Cathay and Origin Leaf.
* Build relationships with store owners, buyers, managers, chefs, hospitality professionals, and other decision\-makers.
* Present products and distribute samples to qualified prospects.
* Identify opportunities for new placements, reorders, and expanded distribution.
* Maintain consistent follow\-up with prospective and existing accounts.
* Track sales activity, account visits, samples distributed, leads, opportunities, and closed deals.
* Represent the company and brands professionally in the marketplace.
* Help identify high\-potential neighborhoods, accounts, and local partnerships for concentrated distribution.
* Collaborate with the broader business development team to grow the brands throughout the New York market.

Required:

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confident, outgoing personality and the ability to engage new people.
* Comfortable with cold calling and in\-person prospecting.
* Self\-motivated and able to work independently in an outside\-sales environment.
* Strong interest in sales, business development, food, beverage, retail, or hospitality.
* Ability to understand and communicate a premium brand story effectively.
* Willingness to spend significant time in the field visiting prospective accounts.
* Reliable, organized, persistent, and results\-oriented.

Preferred:

* Previous outside sales or retail sales experience.
* Experience in food service, specialty food, beverage, tea, coffee, hospitality, or consumer products.
* Existing relationships or industry connections in New York.
* Strong familiarity with specific New York neighborhoods and their retail, hospitality, and food\-service landscape.
* Experience selling to independent retailers, specialty grocery stores, restaurants, hotels, cafés, or other hospitality businesses.

Industry connections are a major plus.We are particularly interested in candidates who already understand the local retail, food service, hospitality, or specialty grocery landscape.

Success in this role will be measured through clear, activity\-based and sales\-based KPIs, including:

* Number of prospective stores and businesses visited.
* Number of new prospects contacted.
* Number of product samples distributed.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of new accounts opened.
* Deals closed and resulting sales.
* Follow\-up and conversion rates.
* Growth of physical distribution within targeted neighborhoods.

**Compensation**

This position offers $20 \- $23/hour \+ commission structure, providing the opportunity to increase earnings based on sales performance and new business generated.

Hours: 30–40 hours per week.

**Why Join Us?**

You will have the opportunity to help build the U.S. presence of two differentiated premium tea brands at an exciting stage of growth. This role is especially well suited for someone who is entrepreneurial, highly social, comfortable creating opportunities from scratch, and excited by the challenge of getting premium products into the right stores and businesses. If you know New York, know how to sell, and enjoy building relationships face\-to\-face, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: $20\.00 \- $23\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 30\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Sysco’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.


**Why you should join our Sales Team:**

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities
* Car allowance (mileage reimbursement for candidates in CA) and cell phone provided
* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

**JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.
* Research customer business needs and develops a mix of products and service to meet needs.
* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.
* Manage deliveries to the routing schedule published by the transportation department; troubleshoot any problems that occur during the order process (for example, out of stock items, special order items, low inventory, etc.).
* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.
* Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, maintaining sales records, processing credits, and pick\-up requests, preparing sales quotes and menu suggestions, and filing reports.
* Other duties may be assigned.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required Education/Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Culinary Arts or related discipline **OR** HSD/GED and 3 years Restaurant Management, B2B or outside sales experience, or equivalent relatable experience including completion of the Sysco Sales Internship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bi\-Lingual
* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

**Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations**

* Valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets company insurability standards.
* Current automobile insurance with the following limits of liability: Bodily injury \- $100,000 each person and $300,000 each accident; property damage \- $100,000 is required

 **Requirement**

* Pass employment testing
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.
* Reside or willing to relocate to the geographical vicinity of territory.

 **Professional Skills**

* Basic PC skills and proficiency with MS Office.
* Ability to read, write, speak English.

 **Competencies**

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

jobs.title: Employee Experience & Talent Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Vega**
--------------


The $250B insurance claims industry runs on fax machines, phone tag, and adjusters buried in paperwork. Cycle times stretch for months. Data is locked in legacy systems. And the workforce is aging out faster than it's being replaced.


Vega is the premier AI\-native claims TPA built to replace that entire stack. Our team is equal parts experienced insurance operators and modern technologists. We care deeply about delivering superior outcomes for our clients, and we want builders that get their hands dirty shipping solutions that move the needle.


Our results: 10x YoY revenue growth, and on track for $XXM run\-rate in under 2 years. Backed by marquee VCs like General Catalyst and Valor.

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for an Employee Experience \& Talent Coordinator to help us hire great people and make our office a place people genuinely love coming to. You'll sit on the People team, splitting your time between recruiting coordination and employee experience — scheduling interviews and running a great onsite candidate experience, keeping our office and employee events running smoothly, and supporting new hires as they onboard.


This is a highly in\-person role: you'll be in our New York office four days a week, and you'll be the person who makes the day\-to\-day experience — for candidates, new hires, and the team — feel organized, warm, and well run.


You'll do well here if you like variety, don't mind switching gears a few times a day, and take real pride in the small things that make an office, hiring \& people processes, feel well run. Bonus points if you're already using AI in your day\-to\-day and are eager to find smarter, more efficient ways to run our tools and workflows.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**In\-Office Experience \& Employee Events**

* Own the day\-to\-day office experience — keeping the space tidy, stocked, organized, and welcoming
* Manage vendor relationships (cleaning, maintenance, food \& beverage, security) and hold them to a high standard
* Plan and run in\-office events, team lunches, happy hours, and other employee experience moments
* Coordinate logistics for visitors, onsite candidates, and company gatherings
* Manage office access including badge distribution
* Host guests, candidates, and visitors so every visit reflects well on the company
* Support space planning, furniture moves, and office improvement projects

**Recruiting Coordination**

* Schedule and coordinate interviews across multiple open roles, keeping candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers aligned
* Own the onsite candidate experience — greeting candidates, running interview days smoothly, and making sure every visit feels polished
* Communicate with candidates throughout the process so they always know what's next
* Use Ashby ATS's scheduling tools to automate where you can and keep manual work to a minimum
* Keep our applicant tracking system accurate and up to date with candidate stages and notes

**People Operations**

* Support new hire onboarding so first days are smooth and welcoming (paperwork, system access, first\-day setup, etc.)
* Help prepare onboarding materials, schedules, and workspace setup
* Field People\-related questions on onboarding, HR data, benefits, and employment verifications
* Process employee changes in HiBob and partner with IT and Payroll to keep new hire information accurate
* Maintain and update People team documentation as processes change
* Pitch in on People team projects as they come up

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 1–3 years of experience in recruiting coordination, office management, or a related operational role
* Strong organizational skills — you can juggle multiple schedules and priorities without dropping details
* A warm, people\-first approach — you make candidates and employees feel welcome
* Experience with Recruiting ATS platforms, calendar tools and HRIS systems a plus (Ashby or HiBob for example)
* Resourcefulness — you figure things out and take initiative rather than waiting to be told
* Startup or fast\-paced environment experience
* Excitement to be in office four days a week and help build the culture in person

**Benefits**
------------

* Competitive Salary
* Equity \- giving you direct stake in the future of an AI\-native industry leader.
* Top\-tier medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* 401k with company match.
* Flexible PTO and a work from home stipend.
* A fast\-paced, high\-talent density team that values transparency and shipping fast.

*We set our salary ranges using compensation data from companies similar to our stage and size. For this role, the estimated salary range for this position is $80,000 \- $95,000\. The actual salary will vary depending on multiple factors unique to each candidate, including location, job\-related knowledge, transferable skills, work experience and our assessment of your level during the interview process. Vega offers equity for all full\-time employees, which is not included in the range listed above and will have an impact on your overall compensation.*

*Vega is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re interested in this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We'd like to consider you for this position and roles that may be a fit in the future.*

*Vega is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Vega considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the New York Fair Chance Ordinance.*


Compensation Range: $80K \- $95K

jobs.description:
NYU Grossman School of Medicine is one of the nation's top\-ranked medical schools. For 175 years, NYU Grossman School of Medicine has trained thousands of physicians and scientists who have helped to shape the course of medical history and enrich the lives of countless people. An integral part of NYU Langone Health, the Grossman School of Medicine at its core is committed to improving the human condition through medical education, scientific research, and direct patient care. At NYU Langone Health, equity and inclusion are fundamental values. We strive to be a place where our exceptionally talented faculty, staff, and students of all identities can thrive. We embrace inclusion and individual skills, ideas, and knowledge.
  

  

*For more information, go to* *med.nyu.edu*, and interact with us on *LinkedIn*, *Glassdoor*, *Indeed*, *Facebook*, *X* *and* *Instagram*.


**Position Summary:**

  

We have an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Research Coordinator. This NIH\-funded project, led by Drs. Erika Raven and Jelle Veraart, focuses on improving women's brain health by identifying why the menopause transition may increase the risk of cognitive decline and Alzheimer's disease. Using longitudinal neuroimaging, plasma proteomics, and detailed clinical assessments of a prospective cohort, the study examines how hormonal changes and menopausal hormone therapy influence brain aging and cognitive outcomes. The goal is to define sex\-specific biomarkers and risk profiles that support earlier detection, more precise prevention, and clinically meaningful strategies to protect women's health across midlife and aging.  

  

In this role, the successful candidate is responsible for providing moderate to advanced range of coordination of Research studies conducted at the Medical Center, assists with the recruitment, enrollment, grant submissions, research data collection and study coordination activities. Performs intra\-operative monitoring and serves as liaison with internal and external funding agencies. Ensures the accurate execution of research protocols in accordance with Good Clinical Practices, HIPAA, and required obligations to patient/subject, Principal Investigator, Research Team and sponsor. Interfaces directly with patients/subjects and Principal Investigator in support of the clinical trials if applicable. Establishes liaisons with relevant parties at the Medical Center that may include: Research Nurses, Research Pharmacists, Program Managers, Medical Technicians, Clinical Information Systems and regulatory Services. Might assist in the initiation and management of research studies. Works under general direction

  


**Job Responsibilities:**


**Study Coordination \& Regulatory Compliance**


* Independently manage the day\-to\-day operations of the study, exercising judgment to resolve protocol deviations, scheduling conflicts, and other non\-routine issues as they arise, escalating to the PIs only when appropriate.
* Interpret and apply IRB and sponsor requirements; prepare, submit, and track continuing reviews, amendments, and reportable events, determining the appropriate course of action for ambiguous or non\-routine regulatory situations.

  


**Participant Recruitment, Screening \& Eligibility Determination**
* Independently review medical records and screening data against complex study eligibility criteria; exercise judgment on borderline or ambiguous cases and make enrollment recommendations to the Principal Investigators.
* Lead the informed consent process, ensuring participants understand study procedures, risks, and rights; manage enrollment, scheduling, and long\-term follow\-up of a prospective cohort.

  


**Data Collection \& Quality Oversight**
* Coordinate and, where applicable, assist with MRI data collection, cognitive testing, and survey administration; select and adapt procedures to participant\-specific circumstances (e.g., menopause status, scheduling constraints) within study guidelines.
* Oversee blood sample collection, storage, and shipping logistics for the plasma proteomics component of the study, ensuring compliance with protocol and chain\-of\-custody requirements.

  


**Data Analysis, Reporting \& Team Liaison**
* Consolidate and analyze longitudinal clinical, imaging, and biomarker data; identify trends and data quality issues, and prepare summaries and recommendations that inform manuscript development and study reporting.
* Serve as primary Liaison between PIs. study team members, core facilities, and external collaborators, exercising discretion in coordinating cross\-functional study activities.

**Additional Position Specific Responsibilities:**

Erika Raven and Jelle Veraart, focuses on improving women's brain health by identifying why the menopause transition may increase the risk of cognitive decline and Alzheimer's disease. Using longitudinal neuroimaging, plasma proteomics, and detailed clinical assessments of a prospective cohort, the study examines how hormonal changes and menopausal hormone therapy influence brain aging and cognitive outcomes. jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location:** Park Schools – Atlanta, GA  

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday  

About Park Schools  

Park Schools is a Montessori\-inspired early childhood education center serving children from **6 weeks to 5 years old**. Our approach combines **Montessori principles, S.T.E.A.M. education, hands\-on learning, and enrichment experiences** to support each child’s academic, social, emotional, and developmental growth.  

We are looking for an organized, energetic, and dependable **Program Coordinator** to help coordinate school programs, special activities, events, and day\-to\-day program operations.  

Position Overview  

The Program Coordinator plays an important role in ensuring Park Schools’ programs and activities are organized, engaging, and successfully implemented.  

This position works closely with school leadership, teachers, staff, families, and outside partners to coordinate enrichment programs, school events, special activities, and other initiatives that enhance the student and family experience.  

The ideal candidate is **highly organized, proactive, detail\-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects at once**. Experience in early childhood education, school administration, program coordination, or a related environment is preferred.  

Key Responsibilities  

* Coordinate and support school programs, enrichment activities, special events, and family engagement initiatives
* Develop and maintain program calendars, schedules, timelines, and activity plans
* Coordinate with teachers and school leadership to ensure programs align with classroom needs and school goals
* Communicate program information, schedules, reminders, and updates to families and staff
* Assist with planning seasonal events, celebrations, field trips, workshops, and other school activities
* Coordinate with vendors, community partners, instructors, and other outside providers when needed
* Track registrations, participation, attendance, supplies, and other program\-related information
* Prepare materials, resources, and supplies needed for programs and events
* Help ensure activities are age\-appropriate, organized, safe, and consistent with Park Schools’ educational philosophy
* Support student transitions and daily school operations when needed
* Maintain organized program records, documents, and reports
* Collect feedback from families, teachers, and staff to help improve programs
* Assist with promoting upcoming programs and events to current and prospective families
* Identify opportunities for new enrichment activities and programs
* Collaborate with school leadership on program improvements and new initiatives
* Provide administrative and operational support as needed

Qualifications  

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred
* Previous experience in **program coordination, education, childcare, school administration, event coordination, or a related field** preferred
* Experience working in an early childhood or Montessori environment is a plus
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to manage multiple projects, schedules, and deadlines
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through
* Comfortable communicating professionally with parents, teachers, vendors, and school leadership
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and other common administrative tools
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with a team
* Positive, professional, and solution\-oriented attitude
* Genuine interest in supporting children, families, and educators

What We’re Looking For  

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just wait for instructions. Our ideal Program Coordinator can **anticipate needs, stay ahead of deadlines, communicate clearly, and take ownership of programs from planning through completion**.  

You should enjoy bringing ideas to life while making sure the details behind the scenes are handled smoothly.  

Why Join Park Schools?  

At Park Schools, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful programs that directly impact children and families. You’ll work alongside a collaborative team committed to creating an engaging, nurturing, and high\-quality early childhood learning environment.  

**Apply today to join Park Schools as our Program Coordinator!**  

Park Schools is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes qualified applicants from all backgrounds.

The Sales Coordinator provides sales and administrative support for assigned MFI trade shows. The position assists the Sr. Show Manager and sales team with prospect research, lead generation, customer communications, sales reporting, database management, sales campaign execution, and day\-to\-day administrative activities. The Sales Coordinator helps ensure that sales activities are organized, accurately tracked, and executed efficiently while providing responsive support to exhibitors and prospects.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


Specific duties and responsibilities in the administration and support of sales programs for MFI trade shows include the following. The individual will also be expected to perform all duties customarily performed by a person holding this position. Other duties may be assigned.

**Sales Support**

* Provide general sales and communications support for assigned MFI trade shows under the direction of the Sr. Show Manager.
* Research potential exhibitors and identify qualified sales leads.
* Conduct initial outreach and cold calls to prospective exhibitors to generate sales leads.
* Respond to routine inquiries and questions from exhibitor prospects and provide information regarding show participation.
* Follow up with prospects and exhibitors as directed by the Sr. Show Manager.

* Support sales programs and initiatives developed by the Sr. Show Manager and Sales Associate.
* Provide information and follow\-up to support the sales process; qualified prospects and sales opportunities requiring negotiation or closing are transitioned to the Sr. Show Manager/Sales Associate as appropriate.

**Sales Administration \& Data Management**

* Maintain an effective and accurate sales database for relevant trade shows.
* Use SAP Sales Cloud to track communications with exhibitors and prospects and maintain accurate sales records.
* Follow up on invoices, confirmations, deadlines, directory listings, ancillary Messe Frankfurt services, and general communications.
* Produce and distribute sales reports.
* Maintain timelines, records, mailing functions, purchase orders, and other administrative materials supporting the sales program.
* Maintain an updated floor plan for relevant trade shows.
* Assist with tracking sales activity, exhibitor commitments, and other information needed by the sales team.
* Ensure sales and exhibitor information is accurate, current, and readily available to the Sr. Show Manager and relevant internal teams.

**Exhibitor \& Customer Support**

* Provide general exhibitor request fulfillment and escalate issues requiring sales or account\-level decisions to the Sr. Show Manager or Sales Associate, as appropriate.

* Coordinate information and services provided to exhibitors as directed by the Sr. Show Manager.
* Assist with miscellaneous projects required by the Sr. Show Manager before and during the onsite operation of relevant trade fairs.
* Provide timely follow\-up and administrative support to ensure exhibitor needs and deadlines are addressed.

**Communications \& Internal Coordination**

jobs.description:
**PI and Referral Operations Coordinator**

We are an outpatient diagnostic imaging center serving patients, attorneys, medical practices, referral networks, and Workers' Compensation partners throughout Metro Atlanta.

We are seeking an organized and proactive PI and Referral Operations Coordinator to manage the operational workflow for personal\-injury, attorney, One Call, Workers' Compensation, insurance, and other external referrals.

This position is responsible for referral tracking, attorney and referral\-partner communication, LOP documentation coordination, authorization follow\-up, appointment coordination, and preparing completed cases for handoff to the billing department.

This is not a medical billing position. The role works closely with our biller, but billing, claims, denials, payments, and collections remain with the billing department.

Spanish\-speaking ability is strongly preferred but not required.

**What you will do**

\- Receive and track personal\-injury, attorney, One Call, Workers' Compensation, insurance, and other external referrals  
\- Maintain an accurate referral tracker with case status, missing information, next action, owner, and follow\-up date  
\- Communicate professionally with attorneys, law offices, clinics, referral coordinators, case managers, and network partners  
\- Confirm that referrals include the required patient, study, order, diagnosis, authorization, and contact information  
\- Track Letters of Protection and related documentation  
\- Request missing LOP documents and route completed packets for management review  
\- Track whether an LOP has been approved, is pending, needs revision, or has been declined  
\- Coordinate with the Patient Access and Imaging Coordinator to schedule patients once the referral is ready  
\- Track prior authorization status when authorization is required  
\- Follow up with referring offices, attorneys, payers, and referral partners regarding missing or delayed information  
\- Track Workers' Compensation information such as claim details, employer information, adjuster information, and authorization status  
\- Coordinate One Call and other referral\-network workflows  
\- Monitor open referrals and identify cases that have stalled  
\- Provide appointment and referral\-status updates to authorized referral sources  
\- Confirm when studies have been completed  
\- Assemble complete front\-end information for the billing department  
\- Route completed cases to the biller with the appropriate order, diagnosis, authorization, LOP, referral, and payer information  
\- Track cases that are waiting for billing handoff or additional documentation  
\- Maintain organized email records, referral notes, and case documentation  
\- Prepare referral\-status and aging reports for management  
\- Escalate legal, financial, clinical, or payer exceptions to the appropriate person  
\- Protect patient privacy and follow HIPAA and Georgia Health Imaging procedures

**What this role does not own**

This position coordinates the referral and documentation workflow but does not independently:

\- Approve or negotiate Letters of Protection  
\- Change legal or financial terms  
\- Provide legal advice  
\- Negotiate referral contracts or reimbursement rates  
\- Submit or correct claims  
\- Perform medical coding  
\- Manage denials  
\- Post payments or ERAs  
\- Handle collections  
\- Approve discounts or write\-offs  
\- Make clinical decisions  
\- Determine MRI protocols or contrast requirements  
\- Provide clinical interpretations  
\- Administer PACS, VPN, DICOM, or network systems

The coordinator is responsible for making sure the case is organized, documented, tracked, and routed to the appropriate decision\-maker.

**Required qualifications**

\- Previous experience in healthcare referral coordination, medical office administration, personal\-injury healthcare, Workers' Compensation, case management, medical records, or a related field  
\- Strong written and verbal communication skills  
\- Excellent organization and attention to detail  
\- Ability to manage multiple active cases with different deadlines  
\- Strong follow\-up skills and the ability to close the loop on open tasks  
\- Professional communication with attorneys, medical offices, patients, and referral partners  
\- Comfort working with email, spreadsheets, referral trackers, and web\-based systems  
\- Ability to maintain confidential patient and legal\-related information  
\- Ability to identify missing information and escalate issues appropriately  
\- Reliable attendance and consistent follow\-through

**Preferred qualifications**

\- Experience coordinating personal\-injury referrals  
\- Experience with Letters of Protection or lien\-based medical workflows  
\- Experience working with attorneys or law offices  
\- Experience with One Call, Workers' Compensation, Scan.com, AIC, or other medical referral networks  
\- Experience tracking prior authorizations  
\- Experience in radiology, orthopedics, pain management, chiropractic, or outpatient imaging  
\- PracticeSuite, EHR, EMR, or medical practice\-management experience  
\- Experience with referral portals or patient scheduling platforms  
\- Familiarity with MRI, CT, ultrasound, or diagnostic imaging workflows  
\- Spanish\-speaking ability  
\- Medical administrative, case\-management, or healthcare coordination training

**The ideal candidate**

The right person is highly organized, persistent, professional, and comfortable working with multiple outside parties. You can maintain a detailed case tracker, identify what is missing, communicate clearly about next steps, and follow a referral until it is scheduled, completed, and properly handed off.

You understand the difference between coordinating a legal or financial document and approving it. You are comfortable escalating exceptions rather than making unauthorized promises to patients, attorneys, or referral partners.

jobs.title: Case Manager and Communications Coordinator, Non-Clinical - Campus Life
jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world\-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

The Case Manager and Communications Coordinator reports to the Associate Director, Student Case Management and Intervention Services and is part of a team that provides immediate support, follow\-up, and care coordination to all Emory University students. This position is integral to student flourishing and creating a sense of belonging here at Emory as professionals within this office are tasked with identifying, assessing, and coordinating care between internal and external University partners to assist students with their overall personal and academic success.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:  

The Case Manager and Communications Coordinator is responsible for the following:* Provides individual assessment, support, and advocacy for all Emory undergraduate, graduate, and professional students.
* Identifies and coordinates care amongst appropriate on\-campus and community resources within a social justice frame work for student needs including but not limited to: housing and food insecurity, financial hardship, mental and medical health concerns, and accessibility needs.
* Assists in the coordination of support mechanisms between individual colleges and offices to university case management.
* Participates in a variety of interdepartmental team meetings as needed to support effective communication, tracking, and follow up with student progress.
* Assists in supporting the relationships developed between campus partners. Examples include, but are not limited to: Student Health Services, Psychiatry, Counseling and Psychological Services, and Student Case Management and Intervention Services and with other partners and constituents in the College and graduate and professional schools.
* Collaborates with and helps market Eagle Food Co\-Op pantry resources.
* Accurately documents all individual student contacts in a timely manner.
* Assists Director in collecting, analyzing, and reporting data for the department for the monthly, annual campus and community assessment process.
* Performs other duties as assigned and necessary.

  

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:* A master's degree in student affairs, social work, psychology, counseling, or related field from an accredited institution, and two years of related work experience.
* May be required to return to campus to support students.
* Services will include consultation with clinical providers, crisis case management, pre\-admission screening for placement, supporting basic needs and report writing.
* Ability to communicate, problem solve, and work effectively within a diverse college environment.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to take initiative and create a vision for completion of required tasks to assist students and campus partners.
* Skilled at creating and establishing strong rapport with students, team, and internal and external University partners.
* Ability to create trust and confidentiality within team, campus partners, leadership, students and campus constituents.


NOTE: Position tasks are generally required to be performed in\-person at an Emory University location. Remote work from home day options may be granted at department discretion. Emory reserves the right to change remote work status with notice to employee.


Additional Details: Emory is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law. Emory University does not discriminate in admissions, educational programs, or employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotions, transfers, discipline, terminations, wage and salary administration, benefits, and training. Students, faculty, and staff are assured of participation in university programs and in the use of facilities without such discrimination. Emory University complies with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Era Veteran's Readjustment Assistance Act, and applicable executive orders, federal and state regulations regarding nondiscrimination, equal opportunity, and affirmative action (for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities). Inquiries regarding this policy should be directed to the Emory University Department of Equity and Civil Rights Compliance, 201 Dowman Drive, Administration Building, Atlanta, GA 30322\. Telephone: 404\-727\-9867 (V) \| 404\-712\-2049 (TDD).
  

  

Emory University is committed to ensuring equal access and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities upon request. To request this document in an alternate format or to seek a reasonable accommodation, please contact the Department of Accessibility Services at accessibility@emory.edu or call 404\-727\-9877 (Voice) \| 404\-712\-2049 (TDD). We kindly ask that requests be made at least seven business days in advance to allow adequate time for coordination.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Why DelRicht Research?**



Would you love to be a part of the cutting edge of healthcare and science innovation? Do you want to be an influential part of a rapidly growing team? Are you looking for a position that has sustainable opportunity for professional growth? If the answer is yes, then DelRicht Research might be the right opportunity for you!

  

**Who We Are**



DelRicht is a clinical research company dedicated to providing an excellent customer experience to all patients that participate in our clinical trials. Our clinical trials provide new treatment options for our patients and ultimately our goal is to get new medications and medical devices FDA approved! We hold our team members to a high standard of excellence and are looking for energetic, positive, quick learners to be a part of our team. Presently our network stretches across 33 sites throughout the United States in 18 states.


**DelRicht Research has been recognized as a Top Workplace for 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026!** This is a testament to our unwavering commitment to creating an exceptional work environment that fosters growth, collaboration, and employee satisfaction.

  

#### **Clinical Research Coordinator's Main Objective**



Overall, the **Clinical Research Coordinator** is responsible for delivering an excellent patient experience while driving accurate, efficient study execution across our clinics, ensuring:


* Patients have a positive, professional, and comfortable experience throughout their time in our clinic
* Patient visits are completed accurately and efficiently, with close adherence to clinical trial protocols
* Patient recruitment, enrollment, and retention activities are executed with strong focus and follow\-through
* Patients are guided through the clinical trials process, ensuring they attend and complete required visits
* Clinical and visit data are entered timely and accurately into required systems and documentation platforms
* Ensuring Sponsors and Clients have amazing customer service when they are onsite at our clinic and assuring we are always providing clear, constant communication with them when they are off site
* Serve as a reliable point of coordination for internal teams, physicians, sponsors, and research partners involved in active studies
* Help maintain strong physician confidence by staying organized, communicating clearly, and keeping stakeholders informed on patient and protocol updates
* Work proactively in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment, solving problems and helping keep daily operations on track


**Skills needed to win:**


* ***Required****:* 1\+ years of professional experience in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation healthcare environment.
* ***Preferred:*** Bachelor's or Associate's degree from an accredited college or university.
* ***Preferred:*** Active RMA, CCMA, CMA, LPN, or RN certificate
* Strong preference for candidates with experience working toward KPIs, metrics, or performance expectations
* This is an onsite Monday\-Friday position
* Coffee drinkers preferred. Tea drinkers accepted.


**The Right Candidate Will:**


* Be self motivated! Energetic! Positive!
* Focus on providing exceptional patient care and creating memorable experiences
* Make sure client satisfaction is a primary focus and that the client is able to achieve and exceed their goals
* Believe in high quality and have a high standard of compliance to our study protocols
* Be remarkably organized
* Be skilled at problem solving, planning and being proactive
* Accept ownership of tasks from inception through completion and assume responsibility for personal success

  

  

**DelRicht Research's Core Values: Production, Humility, Consistency**


**Production:**


* We deliver on our promises
* We have a bias towards action: we value independent problem solving
* We proactively over deliver: we can act without being told what to do and we always have new ideas that will be heard and will improve the company


**Humility:**


* We support each other relentlessly
* We always have enthusiasm: we exhibit passion and excitement about our work which leads to everyone having a 'can do' attitude
* We embrace change: we are excited to always be growing and moving the organization forward which means change is the norm for us
* Coachable: we all love to learn, we are willing to be taught and will adapt quickly
  


**Consistency:**


* We always are able to execute: we get it right the first time and promote 'touch it once' accuracy
* We have persistence: we demonstrate the tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done
* We are calm under pressure: we can maintain stable performance when under heavy pressure or stress


**Team Perks \& Benefits at DelRicht Research:**


* Medical Insurance, with generous employer paid contributions
* Dental and Vision Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability and Group Life Coverage
* Paid Time Off that builds throughout your career with the company
* 401K (\+ discretionary match/profit sharing)
* Quarterly Bonus Plan that clearly outlines your bonus potential per quarter and giving the team the visibility and control to maximize earnings by hitting team goals
* Professional Development Program tailored to each team member's profess goals. Our quarterly goal\-setting initiative is designed to challenge our team members to reach and exceed their potential!
* Success\-Driven Environment where data drives our decisions and insights. Be a part of a winning team that prioritizes transparency, continuous improvement, and success!
  


**Job Type**: Full\-Time 40\+ hrs  

**Salary**: $55,000\-$60,000

  

Visit our website linked below to learn about our company and current clinical trials, see patient testimonials, and check out our careers page!  

Website: www.delrichtresearch.com  

Patient Testimonials: https://delrichtresearch.com/testimonials/

  

*We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants equally wit

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
**BMW of Gwinnett Place, a Penske Automotive Group dealership, is looking for a Sales Coordinator to join our team and deliver extraordinary customer experiences.**


**JOIN OUR TEAM**



At Penske Automotive Group (PAG), we strive to create a positive and challenging workplace that promotes excellence and achievement, and we aim to deliver the very best experience possible to our customers. We are looking for dedicated and motivated professionals who share that same passion to join our team.



Imagine working in a professionally and financially satisfying job where you have the opportunity to make a positive impact on our organization and customers every day. The Sales Assistant assists the dealership Sales team in finding specific vehicles, responding to customers, supporting the sales process, and following\-up with customers after vehicle purchase. The Sales Assistant is required to demonstrate a sound understanding of the latest industry trends, features and benefits of each vehicle. To be a successful Sales Assistant, you should have strong customer service, communication, and problem solving skills.


**WHAT WE HAVE TO OFFER**
