jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Johnstone Supply, North America's leading wholesale distributor of HVACR equipment, parts, and supplies, has a great opportunity to join our team. Over the last seven decades, Johnstone has grown into a multi\-billion\-dollar industry leader with over 470 distributor branches and 6 distribution centers throughout North America. We work with some of the largest companies in the world, including Daikin/Goodman, Bosch, Copeland, Honeywell, Johnson Controls, and Fujitsu, to provide contractors with world\-class products, technical expertise, and quality service.

**Now is the best time to join Johnstone Supply**. Relationship\-building is the key to our success, and it shows in everything we do. The Power of Johnstone is everyone who works with us. Our customers, our partners, and our people. **Johnstone is growing, and so can you.**

  

This position is responsible for selling the Johnstone Advantage, a combination of our services and products, within a specified region or major geographical area, with special focus on the governmental or other specialty customer. In this role, the incumbent aligns the customers’ needs with the service and products that Johnstone offers, with the goal of helping customers to Save Time and Make Money.  

* Manage assigned accounts, by executing sales strategy, initiate contact with existing and potential customers, identify their needs and sell HVAC/R service and products that meet their needs. The above includes:
	+ Keeping customer information updated
	+ Managing individual contract and SKU pricing
	+ Preparing for sales calls specific to the needs of individual customers
	+ Tracking customer activity and trends
	+ Creating goals and forecasts per account
	+ Aligning customer needs with services available through the Johnstone Advantage (e.g., inventory, customer service, warranty, ecommerce, delivery, etc.)
* In conjunction with Sales and Marketing determine market strategies and goals for products and services, targeted toward existing and new markets to achieve company’s goals and objectives.
* Follow up with each account to ensure they understand the marketing and promotional programs such as:
	+ Company\-wide promotions
	+ Hot deals c. Push of Regional Flyers
	+ Communication of “Manager’s Specials”
* Annually, create a listing of at least five prospecting accounts in order to support the branch growth targets established. Creating goals and forecasts per account, following up on leads, developing pricing and various programs to drive growth objectives, and monitoring of sales activity are critical to the overall success of this endeavor
* Conduct business reviews on all top (twenty\-five) accounts in the first quarter of each year. Document their needs and build a strategy to meet their needs.
* Through internal/external training, maintain up\-to\-date understanding of industry trends and technical developments that effect target markets. Work with product managers and vendors on field issues that includes new products, high failure rates, large bid opportunities and competitive pricing.
* Develop and deliver sales presentations and close sales in a professional and effective manner by meeting established sales and revenue goals.
* Monitor competitor products, sales and marketing activities.
* Establish and maintain relationships with industry influencers and key strategic partners. Represents company at trade association meetings to promote product and services.
* Participates in Marketing and Sales meetings, providing customer and product data, strategies and opportunities.
* Develop and maintain communications in a cooperative and professional manner with all levels of staff and customers. This includes:
	+ Completion of weekly call reports
	+ Communicating inventory needs / changes to product managers and purchasing.
	+ Participation in marketing and sales conference calls.
	+ Periodic participation in various task force programs, as needed.
* Identify technical training opportunities with customers.
* Establishes and maintains a consistent company image throughout all product lines, promotional materials and events.
* Performs other duties as assigned. Johnstone Supply believes that each employee’s contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, it is our expectation that each employee will offer his/her services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our endeavors.

  

* B.A. preferred or equivalent; or high school degree or equivalent and 8\+ years related experience and/or training
* 8\+ years related sales experience and/or training
* HVAC/R Industry, or related wholesale industrial product experience required
* Must possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to speak and write proficiently in English
* Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts and draw valid conclusions.
* Must have demonstrated ability to coordinate a high level of activity under a variety of conditions and constraints.
* Must have the ability to make business decisions by an analytical as well as creative process.
* Proficient in Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Requires frequent personal vehicle travel—up to 80%—primarily within local and statewide territories.

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
Description:
**Job Summary**


The Community Manager is responsible for the overall management and operation of an assigned property. The role includes ensuring property performance meets MMG Management’s standards and expectations in terms of occupancy, financial objectives, resident satisfaction, and overall maintenance. The Community Manager leads the on\-site team, oversees daily operations, and ensures the property runs smoothly while adhering to MMG’s mission and core values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Property Operations Management:
* Oversee daily operations of the property, ensuring compliance with MMG policies and procedures as well as local, state, and federal laws.
* Conduct regular property inspections to ensure a high standard of cleanliness, curb appeal, and maintenance.
* Conduct regular file audits to ensure and maintain compliance with MMG policies and procedures as well as local, state, and federal laws.
* Ensure completion of daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual tasks.
* Address resident concerns and resolve issues promptly and professionally to maintain a high level of resident satisfaction.
* Proactively develop solution plans for any identified problems or inefficiencies related to property operations, maintenance, or resident issues.
* Ensure timely and efficient execution of approved plans, following up on progress and making adjustments as necessary to meet property performance goals.


2\. Leasing \& Occupancy Management:

* Manage the leasing process to ensure high occupancy rates.
* Monitor market trends and recommend competitive rental pricing to maximize occupancy.
* Oversee and support leasing team efforts in handling inquiries, conducting tours, and securing new leases.
* Ensure timely processing and management of lease renewals and notices to vacate.


3\. Financial Management:

* Assist in development of and manage the property’s budget, ensuring financial goals are achieved.
* Monitor rent collections, delinquencies, and accounts receivable, acting to minimize loss and optimize revenue.
* Review financial reports, including rent rolls, profit and loss statements, and expense tracking, ensuring accuracy and performance alignment with company and ownership goals.
* Ensure invoices and bills are received accurately within 48 hours of services rendered or per scheduled timeline.
* Timely and accurate invoice and bill entry into property management software within 24 hours of receipt of invoices or billing statements.


4\. Maintenance \& Vendor Management:

* Coordinate and oversee maintenance requests, ensuring timely response and quality workmanship.
* Develop and maintain vendor relationships, negotiating contracts for services such as landscaping, cleaning, and repairs.
* Ensure preventive maintenance programs are implemented and executed consistently to maintain property value.
* Follow vendor selection and set up policies and procedures


5\. Leadership \& Team Growth:

* Provide leadership, ongoing training, and direction to the on\-site leasing and maintenance teams.
* Recruit, train, and onboard new team members in coordination with MMG Policies and standards.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide feedback, and ensure ongoing training and development.
* Foster a positive team environment, promoting MMG’s values of employee engagement and development.
* Prepare staff schedules to ensure optimized daily operations functionality and goals.
* Regularly conduct staff meetings discussing and implementing goals, job duties, achievements, and needs.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting of employee paid hours, commission, bonuses, and other staff compensation items.


6\. Marketing \& Residential Retention:

* Develop and implement marketing strategies to attract new residents and retain current tenants.
* Organize and participate in resident events and initiatives to foster a sense of community and improve resident retention.
* Maintain a professional and approachable presence at the property to ensure excellent customer service and community relations.
* Become active in local business community to develop positive rapport.


7\. Compliance \& Risk Management:

* Ensure the property complies with Fair Housing laws and all other applicable regulations.
* Manage risk by adhering to safety protocols and addressing safety concerns on the property.
* Handle legal issues such as evictions, lease violations, and legal notices in accordance with MMG and local regulations with communication and collaboration with Regional Director and Portfolio Manager.


8\. Reporting \& Communication:

* Prepare and submit accurate and timely weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on occupancy, financial performance, maintenance activities, and other key metrics by deadlines.
* Maintain open communication with the Regional Property Director and Portfolio Manager, providing updates on property performance, challenges, and successes.

**Work Context:**


Communication:

* Required to frequently communicate efficiently, accurately, and timely via email, phone, or specified applications.


 Role Importance:

* Community Managers play a crucial role in overseeing all aspects of a financial asset while maintaining resident satisfaction. They are responsible for managing budgets, supervising staff, and ensuring the properties under their care are well\-maintained and profitable.


 Responsibility for Others:

* Community Managers are responsible for their teams. They are to uphold policy, assess deficiencies, ensure proper training, completion of tasks, and hold teams accountable for shortcomings.


Work Setting:

* Community Manager is an in\-office position to be done at a specific assigned location.


 Job Hazards:

* Possible hazardous conditions include but are not limited to: disgruntled tenants, disgruntled employee, mold, mildew, extreme temperatures.


 Work Attire:

* Business casual attire require. Please see personal appearance policy for specifications.

This position sits within our Marketing division, which plans, directs, implements, and measures marketing programs for our company, people, and software products.

We’re looking for a creative, video\-first Social Media Manager who wants more than a job managing a content calendar. We want someone who sees a boring social post and immediately thinks, “There’s a much better way to do this.” You’ll own the day\-to\-day organic social presence across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and Reddit, with opportunities to explore new channels like TikTok. jobs.title: Inside Sales & Community Engagement Manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Sunpath Solar is seeking an organized, personable, and sales\-oriented Inside Sales \& Community Engagement Manager to help manage the front end of our sales process and ensure prospective customers receive a responsive, professional, and educational experience. This is a blended role combining inside sales, sales administration, customer engagement, and community outreach. The majority of the position is focused on managing inbound leads, qualifying prospective customers, maintaining our CRM and sales pipeline, coordinating appointments and handoffs, following up with opportunities, and supporting the broader sales team. The role also serves as an important public\-facing representative of Sunpath, helping build relationships with community organizations, nonprofits, houses of worship, schools, local governments, and other partners.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people but is also highly organized and process\-oriented — someone who can have a great conversation with a prospective customer and then make sure every note, task, document, and next step is accurately captured and followed through. The role is approximately 70% inside sales and sales administration, with the remaining time focused on customer education, sales support, and community engagement.

**Description**

**Inside Sales \& Lead Management**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for inbound leads from phone, email, website inquiries, referrals, marketing campaigns, and community events.
* Qualify prospective customers by gathering project goals, property and utility information, timelines, decision\-making criteria, and required supporting documents.
* Schedule consultations and proposal reviews, maintain consistent follow\-up with active and older leads, and re\-engage opportunities that have stalled.
* Provide introductory education about solar, battery storage, financing, incentives, project timelines, and Sunpath's sales and installation process.

**Sales Administration \& CRM**

* Maintain complete and accurate CRM records, including lead status, customer communications, qualification notes, appointments, and follow\-up tasks.
* Manage the flow of opportunities through the sales pipeline and coordinate effective handoffs to outside sales representatives and other team members.
* Develop and maintain CRM best practices, dashboards, KPIs, reporting, and sales SOPs from initial inquiry through project turnover.
* Support proposal follow\-up, appointment confirmation, customer communications, and other activities needed to move qualified opportunities toward contract.
* Identify and implement improvements to lead intake, follow\-up, CRM management, and sales processes.

**Community Engagement \& Outreach**

* Develop and maintain relationships with neighborhood organizations, nonprofits, schools, houses of worship, municipal partners, and other community organizations.
* Develop, coordinate, and represent Sunpath at community events, workshops, tabling opportunities, speaking engagements, and other outreach activities.
* Coordinate event materials and outreach efforts with Marketing, and ensure resulting leads are captured, qualified, and followed up through the sales process.
* Track community engagement activities and outcomes to evaluate the effectiveness of events and partnerships.

**Additional Sales Responsibilities**

* Participate in ongoing training on solar technology, products, financing, policy, and Sunpath's consultation process.
* As assigned, present, manage, and close specific sales opportunities in addition to the role's primary inside\-sales responsibilities.
* Provide general support for the Atlanta office, including coordination of facilities, vendors, deliveries, and workspace needs as assigned.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who is also exceptionally organized. They should enjoy talking with customers, asking questions, following up, and helping people navigate a decision, while also being comfortable managing CRM systems, tracking details, maintaining processes, and holding themselves accountable for follow\-through.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**  
We are seeking a **Business Development Representative – Stone \& Cabinet** to drive new business growth by developing customer relationships, reactivating dormant accounts, and expanding market presence in the field. This role is ideal for a sales professional who is strong in prospecting, customer visits, relationship building, and converting small or occasional purchases into stable monthly business. Experience in stone, cabinets, kitchen \& bath, or related building materials is preferred.

**About Us**

BCS Stone \& Cabinets Inc. serves local and regional customers with integrated stone and cabinetry solutions for residential and commercial projects. Backed by the broader Best Cheer platform, our business benefits from vertically integrated sourcing, manufacturing, and supply capabilities built since 1994\.

We support fabricators, builders, contractors, remodelers, dealers, distributors, and other trade customers with slabs, prefabricated countertops, vanity tops, tiles, mosaics, façade panels, cut\-to\-size products, and cabinetry solutions. With factory\-direct advantages, strong inventory support, competitive pricing, and responsive service, we help our customers source efficiently, stay competitive, and keep projects moving.

**Why Choose BCS?**

l **Fast Fulfillment**: Many orders placed before 12 PM can ship the same day, helping our sales team respond quickly and win business.

l **Sales Advantage:** Factory\-direct pricing, strong inventory support, and broad product selection help our field sales team compete effectively and close business faster.

l **Global Powerhouse:** Work for a leader with 30 years of history and the country’s largest inventory of prefabricated stone and cabinetry.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prospect and develop new business opportunities with fabricators, contractors, builders, remodelers, and other target customers in the local and surrounding markets.
* Reactivate dormant accounts and turn inactive customers into recurring purchasing accounts.
* Conduct regular field visits, customer meetings, and jobsite visits to expand market coverage and strengthen customer relationships.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers by understanding their project needs, buying cycles, and product requirements.
* Promote BCS stone and cabinet products by presenting product advantages, pricing value, delivery speed, and inventory support.
* Convert small or occasional purchases into stable repeat business by increasing order frequency, customer retention, and share of wallet.
* Follow up consistently on customer inquiries, samples, quotes, and open opportunities to move prospects through the sales pipeline and close business.
* Identify new sales opportunities through cold outreach, referrals, market visits, trade relationships, and account development efforts.
* Coordinate with design support, operations, and management to ensure accurate quoting, design follow\-through when needed, smooth order execution, and strong customer satisfaction.
* Develop and manage a portfolio of self\-generated accounts, building long\-term customer relationships and driving repeat business growth.
* Maintain organized records of customer visits, pipeline status, account activity, and sales progress, and provide regular updates on market feedback and business opportunities.

**Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of experience in outside sales, business development, field sales, or account acquisition.
* Proven ability to prospect, develop new customers, and grow sales through relationship\-based selling.
* Strong communication, follow\-up, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage a sales territory, and maintain a consistent customer visit schedule.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with customers and business partners.
* Experience in stone, cabinets, kitchen \& bath, building materials, or related industries is preferred.
* Existing relationships with fabricators, contractors, builders, remodelers, or related trade customers are a plus.
* Ability to read basic blueprints, measurements, or project layouts is preferred.
* Valid Georgia driver’s license, good driving record, and ability to be added to the company’s vehicle insurance, if required.
* Bilingual in Spanish, Russian or Chinese is preferred.
* Experience with 2020 Design or similar cabinet design software is a plus.
* Ability to occasionally work weekends, attend customer events, or travel within the assigned market, if needed.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Base salary of $46,000 plus uncapped commission. Typical first\-year earnings are expected to reach $55,000–$100,000\+.
* **Zero\-Threshold Commission:** Earn commission on your very first sale from Day 1—no minimum quota required.
* **Car \& Travel Allowance:** Business mileage reimbursement or company car with fuel expense coverage.
* **Retirement:** 401(k) with 3% Company Match
* **Insurance:** Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision plans.
* **Time Off:** 10 days of PTO in the first year plus Paid Holidays.

**Working Conditions**  
Multiple environments including office and warehouse.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Best Cheer Stone is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Caterpillar's Electric Power Division (EPD) offers integrated solutions, parts, and services to meet the needs of our various commercial and industrial electric power customers. **Clinical Research Coordinator \- Cancer Center \- Clinical Trials Office**

  

**Hiring Department**: Clinical Trials Office


**Location**: Chicago, IL USA


**Requisition ID**: 1042527


**Salary:** The budgeted salary range for this position is $55,000 to $65,000\. Final salary offered will be determined by a thorough assessment of available market data, internal salary equity, candidate experience and qualifications, and budget constraints.


**About the University of Illinois Chicago**


UIC is among the nation’s preeminent urban public research universities, a Carnegie RU/VH research institution, and the largest university in Chicago. UIC serves over 34,000 students, comprising one of the most diverse student bodies in the nation and is designated as a Minority Serving Institution (MSI), an Asian American and Native American Pacific Islander Serving Institution (AANAPSI) and a Hispanic Serving Institution (HSI). Through its 16 colleges, UIC produces nationally and internationally recognized multidisciplinary academic programs in concert with civic, corporate and community partners worldwide, including a full complement of health sciences colleges. By emphasizing cutting\-edge and transformational research along with a commitment to the success of all students, UIC embodies the dynamic, vibrant and engaged urban university. Recent “Best Colleges” rankings published by U.S. News \& World Report, found UIC climbed up in its rankings among top public schools in the nation and among all national universities. UIC has over 300,000 alumni, and is one of the largest employers in the city of Chicago.


This position is intended to be eligible for benefits. This includes Health, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, a Retirement Plan, Paid time Off, and Tuition waivers for employees and dependents.

  

Position Summary
  

This position manages and directs the coordination and timely handling of all components of clinical research protocols, including pre\- and post\-research activities, in and outside of the clinical setting. Responsible for the implementation and conduct of multiple research projects of all clinical phases (I\-IV). Develops and implements effective patient recruitment strategies. Coordinates comprehensive patient protocol treatment schedules to maintain compliance to protocol requirements. Oversees and participates in subject recruitment, screening, scheduling, testing, and data management for multi\-faceted investigation.


Duties \& Responsibilities  

  



* Assist in the establishment and coordinate the implementation of clinical research protocol priorities and organizational structure.


* Notify and inform physicians, clinical staff, affiliates and grant sponsors of adverse events and protocol modifications, including their impact on the clinical research and patients enrolled at UIC.


* Coordinate the activation and maintenance of clinical protocols, including review and completion of submissions, amendments, and adverse event reports as required by the UIC Institutional Review Board (IRB), the National Cancer Institute’s Central IRB, the Cancer Center’s Protocol Review Committee and grant sponsors.


* Review laboratory and clinic procedures sand evaluations regularly that they meet protocol compliance.


* Act as a liaison between physicians, clinical staff and the UIC IRB office, grant sponsors, and regulatory agencies to ensure priorities are clearly communicated and resources are allocated appropriately across multiple ongoing projects.


* Assist physicians and clinical staff in the identification, recruitment and enrollment strategies of patients to increase enrollment and to meet clinical research protocol requirements.


* Execute informed consent process and monitor patient status; enroll patients into research studies, explaining the studies to the patients and their families/loved ones, and obtain/document proper informed consent.


* Ensure that the patient enrollment and research activities comply with the established protocols, regulatory and monitoring agency standards, and grant sponsor guidelines.


* Participate in conducting surveys and quality of life interviews of patients in research protocols.


* Assist investigators in organizing study data for grant progress reports, analyses for meeting presentations and publications.


* Perform other related duties and participates in special projects, as assigned.

  

Minimum Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in nursing, science, or a health\-related field required.
* Certified Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC) or Certified Clinical Research Professional certification

preferred and required within 2 years of hire.
  

* At least one year experience in a research discipline required. Experience in a clinical research setting

and experience working with Federal Regulations and IRB’s required; experience with oncology research
  

protocols highly preferred.
  

* Familiarity with medical terminology and procedures including electronic medical records and billing

preferred.
  

* Ability to manage multiple tasks. Strong interpersonal and customer service skills. Requires excellent

written and oral communications, presentation and computer/pc skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and
  

other related software.
  

* Knowledge of Medicare Coverage Analyses and conventional care cost billing, highly desirable.

Experience with Electronic Medical Records, a plus.
  

* Knowledge of research protocols, principles and procedures; knowledge of aspects of clinical trials such

as screening, interviewing, case report forms; knowledge of experimental design, mathematics, statistics,
  

computerized information retrieval systems, and computer data management; ability to identify, produce,
  

organized, evaluate and interpret data; knowledge of ethics and regulatory procedures (e.g., informed
  

consent process, data safety and monitoring plans, principles of data collection and documentation)

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
The Role

Mabbly is a Chicago Go\-To\-Market Agency, and we are hiring an Account Manager to join our accounts team. You would work alongside our Strategy, Brand, Digital and Product Studios, all of them in the same building as you.

Let's be clear about what this is. We are looking for someone with roughly 2 to 3 years of agency or client\-facing experience who is sharp, malleable and hungry to grow. You would not be the last line of defense on an account. You would have a senior leader above you whose actual job is to make you better at this. Account Director is the destination, not the starting line.

If you have been waiting for a role where someone invests in your trajectory instead of handing you a static job description, this is it.

A word about who we are right now. Mabbly has been an agency for over a decade, but in the past year we rebuilt ourselves to operate like a startup. We run our entire business on Claude, Claude Cowork and Notion. We build our own internal AI agents. We automate anything that should not require a human. You will learn account management the way it is going to be practiced for the next decade, not the way it was practiced for the last one.

Honest note before you apply: this is an intense role inside a company in the middle of its biggest transformation ever. Priorities shift, the pace is real, and the people who thrive here find that energizing rather than exhausting. If you want a quiet seat and a settled playbook, this is not your job. If you want to help write the playbook and grow faster than any big agency would let you, keep reading.

What You Will Do Client partnership and communication

* Own daily client relationships. Build credibility by understanding each client's business, not just their deliverables.
* Run client meetings, calls and status updates with polish, and grow into leading presentations to senior stakeholders.
* Anticipate client questions before they arrive and bring solutions, looping in experts across our studios when needed.
* Prepare clean agendas, recaps, proposals and follow\-ups that keep projects moving.
* Chase what is stuck. A real part of this job is the polite, persistent follow\-up that stops a project sitting for three weeks waiting on one approval. We will teach you the cadence. You have to be willing to run it.

Execution and project ownership

* Manage planning and execution across campaigns, web builds, brand work and content.
* Keep client and internal teams aligned through every stage of the project lifecycle.
* Learn your clients' processes, including the ones that constrain us: approval chains, regulatory review, IT release windows. Knowing that a code change has to be submitted Wednesday to ship Friday is the difference between hitting a date and missing it.
* Work in the weeds. Everyone here does, including the founder.

Quality control

* Be the set of eyes before a client sees anything. Copy, links, formatting, brand consistency, and whether the work actually answers the brief.
* Build and maintain the checklist for your accounts, so quality does not depend on one person remembering.
* Send work back when it is not ready. This is harder than it sounds, and it is a large part of why clients renew.

Scope, budget and systems

* Translate signed work orders into real plans: deliverables and dates in Asana, hours in Harvest.
* Track contracted hours against hours used, and flag movement in both directions. Under\-delivery loses renewals. Over\-delivery loses margin.
* Keep a clear record of what was scoped, what was delivered and what remains, so anyone can answer the question without archaeology.

AI\-powered account operations

* Use Claude, Claude Cowork and Notion daily for meeting prep, recaps, reporting, research and client communication. We will train you. Curiosity is the prerequisite, not prior mastery.
* Help improve our internal AI agents and workflows. Spot something repetitive? We automate it, and you will be part of that.

Growth

* Learn to spot upsell opportunities inside your accounts and bring them forward.
* Take on increasing portfolio ownership as you prove it, on a defined path toward Account Director.
* Communicate account performance and wins to leadership regularly.

What Success Looks Like

We will not tell you to be "measurably more capable every quarter" and leave you to guess what that means. Here is what we actually watch, weekly.

* **Contracted deliverables due this week go out this week.**
* **Contracted hours land between 90 and 105 percent of what the client is entitled to.** Both ends of that band are failures, for different reasons.
* **Fewer than 20 percent of your client tasks are overdue** at any given moment.
* **Every account you touch has a conversation with someone senior on the client side at least every 30 days.**
* **Nothing reaches a client that you have not checked.**
* **Clients renew, and they use your name when they explain why.**

These numbers are on a scorecard the whole delivery team reads every week. You will always know where you stand, which is more than most agencies can say.

Within 18 to 24 months the goal is that you are operating at Account Director level, because we built you there on purpose.

What We Need In You

* **Experience.** 2 to 3 years in client management, account coordination or project management, ideally in an agency or marketing environment. Digital marketing familiarity strongly preferred.
* **Communication.** Excellent written and verbal skills, with the instinct to translate technical ideas for non\-technical audiences.
* **Attention to detail.** You are the person who catches the thing everyone else read past. If you have ever found the typo on the live site, tell us about it.
* **Coachability.** You seek feedback, absorb it fast and apply it. This matters more to us than your resume.
* **Organization.** Comfortable holding several accounts and many moving pieces without dropping any of them.

**Company Overview**


**The Compliance Services Organization didn't exist. We built it.**



MedPro Disposal is the nation's largest privately\-held medical waste company, serving 35,000\+ healthcare providers across 48 states for the past 15 years. On that foundation, we launched MP1 Solutions to pioneer the Compliance Services Organization (CSO) — a new category of operating partner built to replace the fragmented vendor model that has defined healthcare compliance for decades. MP1 Solutions extends MedPro Disposal's operational infrastructure, vendor network, and customer trust into a category we're actively building — and leading — with a technology\-forward approach that's making this model smarter, faster, and more scalable as we grow.


**What we do:** We operate as the single compliance partner for non\-acute healthcare facilities — consolidating every obligation into one coordinated program, assigning one dedicated account manager as the point of accountability, and actively managing the underlying vendor ecosystem through continuous evaluation, negotiation, and optimization on the practice's behalf.


**Why it matters:** Regulated facilities across the country are managing compliance the same fragmented way they always have. We're changing that, backed by 15 years of MedPro Disposal's operational credibility — and we're looking for people who want to help build what comes next.


**Our technology:** We're actively building the AI infrastructure that sits behind this model — automating compliance tracking, surfacing risks before they become problems, and creating a system that gets smarter with every client we add. If you want to build at the intersection of compliance and technology, you're in the right place.


**Our impact:** Our clients never have to worry about something falling through the cracks — obligations are coordinated, tracked, and documented in one place. We audit costs, eliminate overcharges, and deliver proof of compliance that always keeps practices inspection ready. Every client has one dedicated account manager who owns their program end to end. And unlike a traditional vendor relationship, our model is designed to get better over time — continuously re\-evaluated, optimized, and improved with every client we serve.


**Position Overview:**



The Enterprise National Account Manager owns the full\-cycle sales relationship with mid\-market and enterprise healthcare accounts, converting fragmented, incumbent\-vendor compliance arrangements into a single, coordinated MedPro/MP1 partnership. This role exists to grow MedPro's regulated waste and compliance services footprint across multi\-site healthcare organizations by combining disciplined inbound execution with proactive, self\-sourced outbound pipeline\-building. Success looks like a rep who runs a structured, discovery\-driven sales process, consistently converts a defined inbound/plus\-one mix into closed, recurring\-revenue agreements, and reaches full individual quota (\~$35K/month GP) within 90 days — directly fueling MP1 Solutions' growth as the category\-defining Compliance Services Organization.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Own a full\-cycle enterprise sales pipeline: prospect, qualify, propose, negotiate, and close multi\-site regulated waste and compliance service agreements (RMW, shredding, pharmaceutical/Rx disposal, OSHA/HIPAA/BBP training) with mid\-market and enterprise healthcare accounts (ASCs, FQHCs, multi\-location practice groups, health systems).

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Sleep Number® is the leader in personalized sleep wellness. Backed by almost 40 years of innovation, Sleep Number has helped more than 16 million people achieve their best sleep. We are guided by our purpose – improving lives by personalizing sleep. This is exemplified through our 3,000\+ purpose\-driven team members who passionately innovate to drive value creation through our fully integrated business model, owning the process from start to finish, and care at every step.

  

At Sleep Number, you’ll be part of a team redefining what’s possible in sleep, health, and wellness. Backed by world\-class research and continued innovation, we create mattresses with adjustable firmness, pressure relief, and temperature\-balancing comfort that adapt to customers’ changing needs, night after night, year after year. Our people thrive in a culture where purpose, innovation, and customer experience drive every decision. Join us and help shape the future of sleep wellness.

**Make an Impact**


At Sleep Number, we improve lives by personalizing sleep. Join a team driven by curiosity, collaboration, and a passion for helping others thrive—one restful night at a time.


Our Sales Representatives are high\-impact roles that directly contribute to our purpose. This is an exciting opportunity to grow your retail sales career and experience unlimited earning potential.

**The Opportunity – What You’ll Do**

* Discover each customer’s sleep needs and match them with the right Sleep Number products.
* Clearly explain product benefits and current promotions while delivering personalized customer experiences to drive satisfaction and exceed sales goals.
* Proactively nurture prospective customers through outbound calls, with a strong focus on building relationships that generate repeat and new business.
* Work together to maintain a polished showroom and deliver an exceptional store experience.
* Take part in sales practice training and coaching to sharpen your skills.

**What You Bring**

* Strong communication skills with the ability to adapt to diverse customer needs.
* Goal\-oriented and customer\-focused attitude, with a drive to exceed individual and team sales goals.
* Ability to work a flexible retail schedule, including evenings and weekends.
* 1–2 years of retail, customer service, or other customer\-facing experience.
* High school diploma or equivalent.

**Preferred:**

* Experience in consultative or relationship\-based sales, ideally in a commission\-driven environment.
* Comfortable using CRM systems, point\-of\-sale technology, and interactive sales tools (e.g., iPads, apps).
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with a team.

**What Sets You Up for Success**

* You’re energetic, proactive, and thrive in a customer\-focused environment.
* You’re a collaborative team player who welcomes feedback and coaching.
* You’re a tech\-savvy early adopter.

**What You’ll Get**

* Most team members earn a salary of $47,000–$66,000 annually; actual earnings vary and are not guaranteed.
* Guaranteed base pay of $17\.75/hour, along with uncapped commission and bonus potential.
* Non\-draw commission structure.
* The benefit of working for an industry leading brand.
* Health, dental, vision, and 401(k) benefits.
* Flexible paid time off and volunteer opportunities.
* Comprehensive training and career development programs.
* A supportive, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued.
* Access to Sleep Number's bed benefit to experience life\-changing sleep.


\#PIQ

**Wellbeing**


At Sleep Number, wellbeing isn’t a program—it’s part of who we are. We support team members and their families across emotional, financial, career, community, and physical health, all anchored in sleep.

  

Along with competitive pay, eligible team members receive robust benefits such as medical, pharmacy, dental, life and disability insurance, a 401(k), paid time off, and additional resources that promote lifelong wellbeing.

**EEO Statement**


Sleep Number is an equal opportunity employer. We cultivate a workplace culture where everyone is valued, respected, and treated fairly.


Want to help make dreams come true? Apply Today

**Company Description**

**Providers Care Billing LLC** is a growing healthcare revenue cycle management and practice management company headquartered in Schaumburg, Illinois. We provide comprehensive **medical billing, coding, credentialing, revenue cycle management, and practice support services** to healthcare providers and organizations across the United States.

Our medical billing services start at **2\.49%**, providing healthcare practices with a cost\-effective solution to improve collections, reduce administrative workload, and strengthen overall revenue cycle performance.

**Role Description**

We are seeking motivated, confident, and results\-driven **Professional Sales Representatives** to join our growing team at our **Schaumburg, IL office**.

The ideal candidate will have strong **B2B sales experience** and a proven ability to prospect, develop relationships, present solutions, negotiate, and close new business.

The Sales Representative will be responsible for generating new business opportunities and promoting our **medical billing, credentialing, and revenue cycle management services** to physicians, medical practices, behavioral health organizations, dental practices, healthcare facilities, and other healthcare organizations.

* Identify, prospect, and develop new B2B sales opportunities within the healthcare industry.

* Utilize CRM software to track leads, opportunities, follow\-ups, and sales performance.
* Collaborate with the marketing, credentialing, billing, and operations teams to support successful client onboarding and long\-term client satisfaction.
* Stay informed about healthcare industry trends, medical billing challenges, competitors, and emerging business opportunities.

Qualifications

* Proven experience in **B2B sales, business development, or professional services sales**.
* Experience in healthcare, medical billing, revenue cycle management, healthcare technology, or healthcare services sales is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to prospect, generate leads, build a sales pipeline, and close new business.
* Strong cold\-calling, networking, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building abilities.
* Self\-motivated, goal\-oriented, and comfortable working in a performance\-driven sales environment.
* Excellent organizational, follow\-up, and time\-management skills.
* Experience using CRM platforms and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or a related field is preferred.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Annual Compensation: $58,207\.50 – $90,099\.36
* Competitive Base Pay
* Highly Attractive Commission Structure
* Uncapped commission \+ commission accelerators
* Opportunity to earn additional income based on sales performance
* Full\-time position 30\+ hours
* Long\-term growth opportunities within a growing healthcare services organization
* President's Club / Annual Sales Award

Work Setting

**On\-Site – Schaumburg, Illinois**

This position is ideal for a sales professional who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, closing deals, and being directly rewarded for performance.

If you are an ambitious B2B sales professional looking to build a career in the growing healthcare industry, we would like to hear from you.

**Join Providers Care Billing LLC and help healthcare organizations improve their revenue cycle while building a rewarding sales career.**

Benefits:

* Paid time off

**Territory for this opportunity****:**

**Evanston, Des Plaines, Niles, Skokie IL**


Are you an experienced Sales Professional, Restaurant Manager, Culinary Manager or Chef looking for career development opportunities? Join Sysco’s World Class Sales Team and explore all the benefits and perks.


**Why you should join our Sales Team:**

* Competitive base salary, bonus, plus promotional incentive opportunities
* Car allowance (mileage reimbursement for candidates in CA) and cell phone provided
* Career pathing opportunities for both entry level, and experienced individuals
* Opportunity to be part of a purpose driven organization that supports communities and associates
* Specialized sales training
* Individual as well as team\-based selling
* Opportunity to learn different ethnic segments
* Monthly and annual sales rewards and recognition
* Robust benefits package including an Employee Stock Purchase Plan, \& 401(k) with automatic matching

**JOB SUMMARY**  

This is an outside sales position responsible for promoting the company's products and services and for building relationships with new and existing accounts. The main focus is to help Sysco customers succeed while achieving sales and profit goals established by the company. This position may require working some non\-traditional hours (evening, weekends, and holidays) to successfully meet customers' needs.  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Develop new business, penetrate existing accounts, and minimize lost business to achieve profitable sales growth and special objectives within assigned territory.
* Seek and qualify prospects following company account stratification goals.
* Research customer business needs and develops a mix of products and service to meet needs.
* Evaluate market trends and recommend products to customers, based on business needs and goals.
* Be informed of market conditions, product innovations, and competitors' products, prices, and sales; share information with customers as part of value\-added services provided.
* Answer customers' questions about products, prices, availability, and product use.
* Provide product information and practical training to customer personnel.
* Drive personal vehicle to customer accounts, conventions, company meetings, etc.
* Communicate and collect accounts receivable as necessary, working with the credit department and client; collect all balances due based on approved credit terms.
* Manage deliveries to the routing schedule published by the transportation department; troubleshoot any problems that occur during the order process (for example, out of stock items, special order items, low inventory, etc.).
* Participate in company functions, promotions, customer visits, and customer events.
* Attend and participate in general sales and district meetings.
* Engage in ongoing training sessions.
* Assist with the training of new employees as requested.
* Review and analyze daily and weekly reports such as special\-order requests, customer bid files, and sales/gross profit margin data.
* Perform administrative duties, such as preparing sales budgets and reports, maintaining sales records, processing credits, and pick\-up requests, preparing sales quotes and menu suggestions, and filing reports.
* Other duties may be assigned.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required Education/Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, Hospitality, Culinary Arts or related discipline **OR** HSD/GED and 3 years Restaurant Management, B2B or outside sales experience, or equivalent relatable experience including completion of the Sysco Sales Internship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bi\-Lingual
* Restaurant Management, Foodservice Outside Sales, Chef Experience preferred

**Certificates, Licenses, and Registrations**

* Valid driver’s license with a driving record that meets company insurability standards.
* Current automobile insurance with the following limits of liability: Bodily injury \- $100,000 each person and $300,000 each accident; property damage \- $100,000 is required

 **Requirement**

* Pass employment testing
* Must sign Sysco Protective Covenants Agreement.
* Reside or willing to relocate to the geographical vicinity of territory.

 **Professional Skills**

* Basic PC skills and proficiency with MS Office.
* Ability to read, write, speak English.

 **Competencies**

* Building Trust
* Building Customer Loyalty
* Follow\-up
* Sales Ability / Persuasiveness
* Managing Work
* Adaptability
* Communication

jobs.description:
**$3,900 Sign\-On Bonus\***


**Sales Representative**


**Build Your Career With Purpose**


At POWER, sales is more than closing deals \- it's about helping homeowners make confident decisions while building a career with unlimited growth potential. As a full\-time Sales Representative you'll receive hands\-on training, mentorship, and the tools you need to develop professionally, earn uncapped commissions, and make an impact from day one.


**How you’ll make an impact**


* Meet with homeowners to deliver engaging presentations on our energy\-efficient home remodeling products and services.
* Learn POWER’s proven sales process through ongoing training and coaching.
* Build meaningful relationships with customers by understanding their needs and recommending personalized solutions.
* Collaborate with teammates and mentors to continuously improve your sales approach.
* Develop communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills that prepare you for long\-term career growth.


**How you’ll partner with others**


* Partner with experienced sales leaders who will coach and support your development.
* Participate in weekly team meetings, training sessions, and collaborative learning opportunities.
* Contribute to a team culture built around mentorship, accountability, and celebrating success.


**What success looks like**


* Deliver exceptional customer experiences throughout every appointment.
* Consistently apply POWER’s sales process and product knowledge.
* Achieve individual sales goals while contributing to overall team success.
* Continue developing the skills needed for advancement within the organization.


**What It Takes To Succeed**


***You have these minimum qualifications:***


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence speaking with new people and presenting information.
* A self\-motivated mindset with a desire to learn and grow.
* Ability to work independently while thriving in a team environment.
* High school diploma or equivalent.


***It would be helpful if you have:***


* Previous experience in sales, customer service, hospitality, or another customer\-facing role.
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience delivering presentations or working toward performance\-based goals.


**Why You’ll Love Working Here**


At POWER, your success starts with our investment in you. From paid training and mentorship to comprehensive benefits and career advancement opportunities, we're committed to helping you build a rewarding long\-term career.


**Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy include:**


* **Competitive Earning Potential** \- Earn $72,000 \- $130,000 each year paid at an hourly rate which includes uncapped commissions and bonuses
* **Comprehensive Health Coverage** \- Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance plans designed to support you and your family.
* **Retirement Savings** \- Build your future with a 401(k) plan that includes company matching.
* **Paid Time Away** \- Take advantage of paid holidays and paid parental leave so you can focus on what matters most.
* **Wellness Support** \- Access to wellness programs that help you stay at your best.
* **Professional Development** \- Receive industry\-leading training, mentorship, leadership development, and ongoing opportunities for career growth.
* **Performance Recognition** \- Celebrate your success with incentive vacations, exclusive rewards, and recognition for top performance.
* **Tools For Success** \- Work with modern technology and resources that help you serve customers and maximize your potential.
* **An Inclusive Culture** \- Join a team that values diverse perspectives, supports employee resource groups, encourages veterans to apply, and is committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.
* **Community Impact** \- Give back through volunteer opportunities and company initiatives that make a positive impact in the communities we serve.
* **Modern Workspaces** \- Collaborate in thoughtfully designed office spaces with opportunities for relocation as your career grows.


**Office Locations**


* Oakbrook Terrace, IL
* Rosemont, IL
* Tinley Park, IL

  

  

*\*POWER offers a $3,900 sign\-on bonus, which will be paid weekly in $325 increments over the course of twelve weeks of initial training. The full sign\-on bonus is contingent on successfully completing the twelve weeks of initial training*

  


*Power Home Remodeling Group is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to hiring a diverse and talented workforce. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please submit the accommodation request to recruiting@powerhrg.com*

new_jobs.title: Purchasing and Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

We're looking for a detail\-oriented, communicative, and self\-motivated individual to join our office team. This role sits at the intersection of purchasing, vendor coordination, customer communication, and production support. You'll be a key link between our shop floor, our suppliers, our outside processing vendors, and our customers — keeping jobs moving and people informed.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Purchasing \& Procurement**

* Source and purchase raw materials (bar stock, plate, extrusions, etc.) based on job requirements and production schedules
* Solicit and compare quotes (RFQs) from material suppliers and select vendors based on price, lead time, and quality
* Issue and manage vendor purchase orders accurately and on time
* Receive purchase orders into the ERP system (JobBOSS), verify quantities and documentation, and flag discrepancies

**Outside Processing Coordination**

* Submit work orders to outside processing vendors (plating, heat treat, anodize, grinding, etc.)
* Actively follow up with vendors to ensure on\-time return of parts relative to job due dates
* Maintain visibility into all open outside processing jobs and escalate delays proactively
* Track and manage outside processing aging to prevent jobs from slipping

**Customer Communication**

* Provide proactive order status updates to customers via phone and email
* Respond to delivery inquiries and communicate any schedule changes clearly and professionally
* Coordinate with internal team members to gather accurate delivery information before communicating externally

**Production \& Team Support**

* Work closely with the shop floor, scheduling, and management to understand priorities and help meet production deadlines
* Assist with data entry, job tracking, and record\-keeping in ERP and project management systems
* Support the quoting team by gathering material and outside processing costs for open RFQs
* Help maintain organized files for POs, certifications, material certs, and vendor records
* Assist with accounts payable tasks such as matching vendor invoices to POs and coding for approval
* Handle incoming calls and route or respond as appropriate
* Pitch in on general office tasks as needed — this is a small team and we all wear multiple hats

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 2\+ years of experience in a purchasing, operations, or customer service role — ideally in manufacturing, machining, or a related industry
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple open tasks simultaneously without dropping the ball
* Clear and professional written and verbal communication
* Comfortable working in an ERP system for PO creation, receiving, and job tracking
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word)
* Self\-starter who doesn't need to be micromanaged — you take ownership of your work

**Preferred**

* Experience in a machine shop, job shop, or precision manufacturing environment
* Familiarity with outside processing operations (plating, anodize, heat treat, etc.)
* Experience with JobBOSS or similar job shop ERP
* Experience with Monday.com or similar operations/project management tools
* Understanding of basic manufacturing documents: travelers, certifications, inspection reports

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Pay Rate: $26\.00 – $30\.00 per hour, depending on experience
* Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Monday – Friday

Pay: $26\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Production Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Office \& Production Coordinator \| North Hollywood, CA \| Full\-Time, On\-Site**

About us

Dreamliner Construction is a licensed home remodeling company (CSLB \#1130285\) serving Los Angeles and the Inland Empire. We build kitchens, bathrooms and room additions, and more. We are growing fast and need someone to run the paperwork side of every job so our crews and sales team can keep moving.

The role

You are the engine behind every project. From the moment a job is sold until the final invoice is paid, you keep the file complete, the permits moving and the homeowner informed. This is a production\-focused office role with lots of phone and computer time.

What you will do

* Build and manage project files: contracts, change orders, invoices, permits and photos
* Prepare contracts and send them out for electronic signature, then track them until signed
* Submit and follow up on city permit applications and inspections
* Create and send invoices and record payments in QuickBooks
* Keep trackers and documents up to date in Google Sheets and Google Docs
* Call and email homeowners with project updates, scheduling and next steps
* Reach out to potential clients and follow up on leads
* Order office supplies and marketing materials (flyers, door hangers, yard signs, business cards)
* Support the owners, sales team and field crews with whatever keeps jobs on track

What you bring

* 2\+ years of office or administrative experience (construction or remodeling is a big plus)
* Comfortable with Google Sheets, Google Docs and QuickBooks
* Clear, friendly communication on the phone, by email and in person
* Organized with details: you notice when a signature, date or document is missing
* Comfortable switching between phone calls and computer work all day
* Good energy, open to learning and hungry to grow
* Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus

What we offer

* $26/hour, full\-time (about $4,500/month)
* Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:00 PM
* Paid holidays and paid sick leave
* Performance bonus
* A clear path to Production Manager as the company grows
* Direct training from the owners

How to apply (required)

We do not hire from resumes alone. To be considered, record a short video (3 minutes max) answering the five questions below, and send the link to info@mydreamliner.com with the subject line "Office Coordinator: Your Full Name". Loom, unlisted YouTube or a Google Drive link all work. Please make sure the link is viewable.

Start your video by saying the word "Blueprint."

* Tell us about yourself and why this role at a remodeling company caught your eye.
* Describe a time you managed a lot of files, deadlines or moving pieces at once. How did you stay organized?
* Tell us about a time you handled a frustrated customer on the phone. What did you say, and how did it end?
* What is something you taught yourself recently, and how did you learn it?
* Tell us about a mistake you made at work and what you did about it.

Applications without a video will not be reviewed.

Pay: $25\.78 \- $29\.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

ROLE OVERVIEW


We’re hiring a hands\-on freelance Social Media Manager to craft compelling content for our projects and brands. You’ll identify standout moments in existing material, develop original concepts, and shape and edit assets with a sharp eye for quality, audience behavior, and brand voice, managing each piece through approval and publication. You’ll plan original content and handle lightweight capture within the agreed scope. Dream Three sets brand direction and approval boundaries; you own the editorial proposal and day\-to\-day delivery. This is an execution\-focused individual contributor role for someone who combines creative judgment, strong craft, and dependable follow\-through.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

* You establish a reliable weekly cadence by setting clear priorities, crafting review\-ready content, publishing posts on time, and organizing it all within a well\-defined workflow.

* Your content has clear hooks, accurate context, and purposeful pacing; performance findings inform the next round of work.

WHO YOU ARE

* You move efficiently without compromising taste, accuracy, or attention to detail.
* You welcome direct creative feedback and translate it into stronger work.
* You understand platform\-native short\-form storytelling and can explain why a moment or a treatment is effective.
* You see the edit before it’s filmed. You recognize promising hooks and turn an idea or raw material into a clear execution. You pivot quickly when content isn’t landing and recommend stronger alternatives.
* You are organized and dependable: you communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and keep approvals moving.
* You take ownership of the content process from concept or source selection through publication.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* **Editorial Planning:** Translate approved brand direction into a practical calendar and source selections, original concepts, and editorial proposals.
* **Content Production \+ Packaging:** Work with existing and newly captured material: select moments, edit short\-form video, and prepare accurate captions, titles, covers, and platform\-specific versions.
* **Capture:** Plan and capture lightweight original or event content when included in the agreed scope, with location, resources, and delivery requirements confirmed in advance.
* **Workflow \+ Approvals:** Prepare batch review packs, consolidate feedback, maintain approved versions, and distinguish quality control from permission to publish.
* **Publishing:** Schedule and publish authorized content; verify the correct brand channels, formats, captions, links, tags, thumbnails, accessibility, metadata, and live results.
* **Community:** Manage routine engagement within agreed coverage and response guidance; escalate sensitive, commercial, or reputational issues.
* **Performance Learning:** Track relevant content and channel results; provide a concise monthly report outlining specific improvements to test.
* **Access \+ File Hygiene:** Maintain source and project files and publishing records, and flag permission or security issues.


ROLE REQUIREMENTS

* Ability to manage the end\-to\-end workflow: develop concepts or select source material, produce, obtain approval, publish, engage, and learn.
* Ability to create original social content as well as repurpose existing material, while managing a brand’s deadlines and concurrent deliverables.
* Practical analytical judgment: turn performance evidence into specific production or publishing adjustments.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to adapt accurately to distinct brand voices.
* Professional discretion, organization, adaptability, and reliable follow\-through.


TOOLS YOU’LL USE

* Adobe Premiere Pro; Photoshop, Canva, or equivalent tools for supporting assets.
* Frame.io, Dropbox, Asana, Slack, and the designated social publishing suite.
* Meta Business tools, TikTok Business Center, and YouTube Studio within assigned permissions.


PLUSES

* Multi\-brand, entertainment, or public\-facing brand experience.
* Experience editing comedy, conversation, interviews, or podcast material.
* Thumbnail design or simple motion graphics skills.


ADDITIONAL DETAILS

* **Engagement \+ Fees:** Freelance contract. Hourly or fixed fees are agreed against a defined scope.
* **Scope:** Start with one brand and agreed\-upon workload, deliverables, and service windows. Additional work may be agreed upon based on delivery, capacity, and mutual fit.

* **Term:** The initial engagement and any renewal terms are agreed upon in writing. This is a nonexclusive freelance opportunity.
* **Flexibility:** Evening/weekend coverage, capture dates, travel, and related fees or expenses are agreed upon in advance.

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

new_jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

  

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


**Position Description:**

**This role will be based in Santa Clara California, Sparks, NV, San Antonio, TX, Reno, NV following our flexible work policy (3 days in\-office and 2 days flexible).**

* Vantage is looking for an Assistant Project Manager to assist the Special Projects team and Project Managers to drive success on new and ongoing construction projects.
* The position covers all aspects of a construction project. Areas of expertise that require minimal oversight and autonomy in the following areas:
* RFP development and overall project budgeting
* Pre\-bid oversight and coordination assistance
* Assist managing all design phases and documents
* Assist managing, coordinating and supervising design\-build contractors and vendors
* Assist and/or coordinate with internal stakeholders and subject matter experts
* Assist with oversight of physical construction activities
* Participation in commissioning
* Assist, manage and own project close outs: Punch list, as\-builds, warranties, OEM, etc.
**Essential Job Functions:**

* Report to and assist Vantage Special Projects team and assigned manager.
* Proficient at taking initiative, problem solving, time management, and thinking outside the box.
* Gather vendor proposals, invoicing documents and ensure vendor deliverables are delivered in a timely manner.
* Manage individual tasks throughout the construction process including submittals, RFI process, drawings and safety reporting.
* Proficient understanding of contract types; i.e., GMP, Lump Sum, NTE, etc.
* Proficient understanding of invoicing; i.e., lien waivers, pay applications, retention, etc.
* Proficient in leading OAC meetings, coordination meetings, and facilitating stakeholder meetings.
* Coordinate VDC led meetings, manage meeting minutes and drive actions to closure.
* Oversee OFCI equipment release, delivery, deficiencies, startup and commissioning.
* Ensure project compliance, track construction progress via daily logs, site inspections and QA/QC.
* Manage project close\-out and documentation.
 **Duties:**

* Manage small to medium sized projects with Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager oversight.
* Occasionally, based on Assistant Project Manager’s experience, readiness and learning development; individual may be included in larger more technical projects to assist Special Projects Project Manager or Sr. Project Manager.
* Assist and or manage multiple projects concurrently and projects in various locations.
* Coordinate internal alignment on project document reviews, budgeting and financial exercises and purchase order management.
* Enforce project quality controls and safety programs through an in\-depth understanding of the partner contracts and design docs.
* Manage and provide weekly HRA inspections to adhere to VDC safety metrics.
* Perform tasks accurately and execute with minimal supervision.
* Assist Vantage PM(s) in preparing monthly financial updates and forecasts.
* Manage contractor billing to ensure accuracy of scope included in each billing and timely review of all pay applications.
* Manage change orders and review process independently. Provide timely review of change orders with accuracy of scope and costs.
* Input PO requests in the financial system, track and manage distribution process to all Vantage vendors.
* Facilitate design page\-turns, document reviews, meeting minutes, capture deliverables and action items for internal stakeholders and direct contractor design partners.
* Manage Vantage vendor partners to ensure completion of their scope and overall project completion (i.e., Signage, furniture, AV, etc.)
* As required, manage design team/contractors throughout each project.
* Work closely with VDC Ops to coordinate ongoing site activities, develop and track MOPs and provide customer support as necessary.
* Manage, organize and maintain internal file storage.
* Own internal and external project closeout requirements.
* Assist and track as\-builds, permits, and coordinate with local authorities to ensure permits and documents are current.
* Time to time, additional duties may be assigned by management.
 **Job Requirements:**

* Bachelor of Science in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a similar field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of 5\+ years’ experience as a Project Engineer in Construction Project Management assisting or supervising construction projects of increasing complexity is required.
* Data Center, Owner’s Representative and/or General Contractor experience is highly preferred.
* Experience in CSA (civil, structural, architectural) and MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) construction management is a requirement.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management tools like MS Project, P6, Procore and Bluebeam.
* Up to 10% travel may be required.

**Physical Demands and Special Requirements**

At 2K, we create some of the most iconic and culture\-shaping video games in entertainment, including ***NBA® 2K***, one of the top\-selling franchises in the world, and legendary titles like ***BioShock®****,* ***Borderlands®****,* ***Mafia****,* ***Sid Meier's Civilization*****®**, and***XCOM®***, as well as fan favorites ***WWE® 2K****,* ***TopSpin®***, and ***PGA TOUR® 2K****.* We build unforgettable experiences by pushing the boundaries of creativity, authenticity and innovation across every genre.
