**POSITION:** Project Coordinator  

**DEPARTMENT:** City Bar Justice Center, Federal Pro Se Legal Assistance Project – S.D.N.Y.  

**POSITION REPORTS TO:** Director, FedPro\-SDNY  

**LOCATION:** Hybrid (New York, NY)  

**FLSA STATUS**: Non\-exempt (Local 153, Office and Professional Employees International Union)  

  

The City Bar Justice Center is the largest division of the New York City Bar Association's charitable affiliate, the City Bar Fund. For nearly 50 years, our organization has furthered access to justice by addressing the unmet civil legal needs of New Yorkers facing poverty and other systemic socioeconomic barriers. The Justice Center mobilizes law firms, corporate legal departments, and other legal institutions to provide pro bono legal services; educates the public on legal issues; fosters community relationships; and shapes public policy. Its civil justice projects deliver high\-quality services through brief advice, referrals, and direct representation. Last year, more than 3,300 pro bono attorneys partnered with the Justice Center to provide free legal services to over 23,000 New Yorkers who could not afford private counsel.  

  

**PROGRAM FUNCTION**  

FedPro\-SDNY is an innovative initiative providing free, limited\-scope legal assistance to “pro se” individuals – i.e., those representing themselves, including incarcerated individuals – while litigating civil cases in the Southern District, mostly in the areas of civil and prisoner rights, employment discrimination, contracts/warranties, and consumer/finance matters, and a range of other claims touching on core individual rights and the protection of livelihoods. Working closely with a tight\-knit FedPro\-SDNY team, project coordinators actively assist with litigant intake and case management, help to determine which litigants can be helped by the Project, and liaise with law student interns, volunteer attorneys and a social work team to support litigants served by FedPro\-SDNY.  

  

**JOB FUNCTION**  

The City Bar Justice Center (CBJC) seeks an enthusiastic and organized individual to join the three\-person project coordinator team with our Federal Pro Se Legal Assistance Project operating in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York (FedPro\-SDNY). One project coordinator (similar to paralegal) position is available now for a candidate committed to expanding access to justice.  

  

**This role works closely with and under the supervision of the FedPro\-SDNY Director to handle the following areas of responsibility, among others:*** Serve as the first point of contact for pro se litigants seeking legal assistance, including interviewing and screening litigants for eligibility for FedPro\-SDNY services by phone, email, and/or in person at FedPro\-SDNY’s lower Manhattan courthouse office, while providing caring follow\-up to the pro se litigants, who typically seek our assistance at vulnerable moments in their lives.
* Carefully maintain case, program/activity, and volunteer records and databases, and run and analyze statistical and other reports.
* Provide administrative help by helping to engage interns and volunteers, and organizing virtual and in\-person training programs, events, and legal clinics.
* Liaise with attorney volunteers from large firms, corporate legal departments, and solo practices.
* Assist in preparing grant applications and reports, and in designing and writing program content such as blogs, reports, legal informational resources, presentations and social media posts.
* As needed, provide general administrative support, including with new FedPro\-SDNY programming and with other CBJC projects.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS*** Bachelor’s degree or substantially equivalent work experience in a professional setting.
* Minimum 6 months of work experience (relevant internships acceptable).
* Strong data entry, organizational and project management skills; high attention to detail; excellent verbal and written communication skills; comfortable communicating both by telephone and in direct contact with the public; self\-starter with a record showing (or a demonstrable capacity for) consistent professional timeliness and reliability.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365, and the ability to quickly learn and effectively use LegalServer and other technology.
* A curiosity to learn about various federal laws and civil litigation procedure.
* A team player with an ability to interact respectfully with people of different backgrounds and perspectives on the justice system, including litigants, fellow staff members, volunteer attorneys, and court staff and other government employees, and desire and capacity to engage with members of the public in a respectful and sensitive way, many of whom suspect institutions and the legal profession, and some of whom experience legal problems compounded by mental health struggles.
* Demonstrated enthusiasm for public interest legal work, serving those who struggle with a lack of resources, and providing legal assistance to historically underserved communities.
* Professional working proficiency in Spanish or another non\-English language a plus but not required.

*Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are not able to sponsor visas for this position.*  

  

We are looking for a candidate for this currently open position who is willing to make a minimum commitment of two years to the Project Coordinator role. This is a hybrid position for which candidates must be available for 2\-3 in\-person workdays during standard business hours, primarily at FedPro\-SDNY’s downtown Manhattan courthouse, with the balance of time split between work\-from\-home, work at CBJC’s main offices in midtown Manhattan for supervision, team, and committee meetings, and occasional other local work\-related travel.

new_jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------


Federal Reserve Bank of New York
This role is based out in New Jersey and New York.  

  

When you work at the New York Fed, you have the opportunity to make an impact in our communities and across the nation. Our mission\-driven, curious, and dedicated colleagues apply their diverse perspectives and unique talents to support the strength of the U.S. economy and stability of the global financial system. At the Bank, we work full\-time onsite with our teams. As part of the Operations and Resiliency Group, the Reserve Bank Accounts and Services (RBAS) is responsible for the administrative, business, risk, and compliance activities related to the provision of master accounts and Federal Reserve financial services for second district customers.


The RBAS team functions as the central communication and coordination liaison between the Bank's internal and external customers, with respect to on\-going account management for the duration of the customer relationship.


Your role as Account Manager:


Reporting to the RBAS Director, you will serve as a key leader in the New York Fed’s provision of accounts and services to financial institutions located in the second Federal Reserve district—helping to driving strategy, planning, and decision\-making to ensure the delivery of high\-quality outcomes for our customers. In this role, you will have the opportunity to resolve complex issues and collaborate with stakeholders across Legal, Credit, Risk, Compliance, and Policy, while maintaining critical relationships with other stakeholders within the Federal Reserve System.


This role requires the responsibility to work independently with limited supervision for a portfolio of customers with a high degree of collaboration with multiple stakeholders to drive outcomes, requiring keen attention to details, organization, and the ability to balance competing priorities.

* Manage end\-to\-end relationships for a portfolio of customers.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to execute business initiatives and to obtain relevant input to business actions.
* Demonstrate knowledge to provide guidance to stakeholders regarding Federal Reserve System account and financial services policies, practices and procedures.
* Accountable owner for the end\-to\-end processes for account opening and related on\-going account maintenance activities, working with Federal Reserve System stakeholders.
* Prepare written reports that interpret and synthesize analyses, making connections between recommendations and the bigger picture.
* Contribute and/or lead bi\-weekly stakeholders’ meetings on account access reviews.
* Provide peer reviews and resolve difficult and complex problems related to account and financial services.
* Support quarterly Board Database reporting/reconciliations on existing and pending account requests and conduct ad\-hoc querying/analysis for stakeholders.
* Administer the Account Request Tool (ART) to facilitate requests for Federal Reserve accounts and financial services.
* Engage and support appropriate stakeholders for requested information/presentations for Compliance Testing/Risk/Audit review.
* Manage projects within the role.

**What we are looking for:**

* Strong customer service, critical thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to quickly learn business and related process and work independently to deliver outcomes.
* Advanced collaboration, written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively make connections, ask insightful questions, and synthesize information within deadlines.
* Strong attention to detail and good organizational skills.
* Understanding of internal controls and risk management practices and/or relevant disciplines (e.g. background or experience in BSA/AML and OFAC Compliance) and an interest in understanding applicability to Reserve Bank operations.
* Knowledge of project management methodologies and tools.
* Strong analytical, quantitative skills, including ability to interpret policy requirement.
* Advanced PC and technical proficiency (Word, Visio, PowerPoint, Excel, Access, SharePoint Online, Tableau, SalesForce, Launchpad Pro (Generative AI), and collaboration tools).

**Application Deadline:** September 30, 2026


Salary Range: $140,000 \- $180,000


We believe in transparency at the New York Fed. This salary range reflects a variety of skills and experiences candidates may bring to the job. We pay individuals along this range based on their unique backgrounds. Whether you’re stretching into the job or are a more seasoned candidate, we aim to pay competitively for your contributions.

**Our Touchstone Behaviors**—Communicate Authentically, Collaborate Inclusively, Drive Progress, Develop Others, and Take Ownership—help shape the culture of the Bank. They also provide a shared language for how we work together and achieve success, and they set clear expectations for leading with impact at


every stage of your career with us. Learn more.


Benefits:


Our organization offers benefits that are the best fit for you at every stage of your career:

* Fully paid Pension plan and 401k with Generous Match
* Comprehensive Insurance Plans (Medical, Dental and Vision including Flexible Spending Accounts and HSA)
* Subsidized Public Transportation Program
* Tuition Assistance Program
* Onsite Fitness \& Wellness Center
* And more

new_jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

JPMorganChase AI Research (AIR) is a global team of research scientists, engineers and product managers that develops novel AI capabilities and partners across the firm to translate breakthrough AI/ML techniques into deployed solutions. The team brings together researchers across multi\-agent systems, foundation model training, reinforcement and continual learning, multimodal document AI, formal reasoning, planning and verification, and synthetic data generation – alongside experts in trustworthy AI, privacy, and cryptography – to solve hard problems end\-to\-end in ways that are secure, reliable, and scalable in financial services.


AI Research sits within the Chief Data \& Analytics Office (CDAO) at JPMorganChase which is responsible for accelerating the firm's data and analytics journey. This includes ensuring the quality, integrity, and security of the firm's data, as well as leveraging this data to generate insights and drive decision\-making. The CDAO is also responsible for developing and implementing solutions that support the firm's commercial goals by harnessing artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to develop new products, improve productivity, and enhance risk management, effectively and responsibly.


As Business Operations Lead, VP/ED, supporting AI Research, you will be the strategic operating partner to the leadership of one of the most ambitious AI research organizations in financial services. You will shape how the team plans, invests, executes, and scales – aligning talent, capital, and infrastructure behind a bold research agenda. This is a rare seat at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI, executive strategy, and enterprise execution – ideal for a leader who thrives on turning ambiguity into structure and enabling brilliant people to do their best work.




**Job responsibilities**

* Serve as the strategic operating partner and chief of staff to the Head of AI Research, driving execution of the team's strategy and long\-term roadmap.
* Orchestrate executive management reviews, leadership offsites, and deep\-dive sessions – shaping the agenda, framing key decisions, and driving follow\-through on outcomes.
* Lead portfolio strategy and governance: intake and prioritization of research and line of business initiatives against the highest\-value opportunities across the firm.
* Own executive reporting and narrative development – communicating progress, impact, and strategic direction to senior stakeholders across CDAO and the lines of business.
* Steward the financial resources of the team to enable innovation and implementation in a fiscally responsible way – partnering with finance on multi\-year planning, headcount strategy, and disciplined allocation across talent, compute, and external commitments.
* Shape the team's presence at flagship, signature AI/ML conferences – setting a coherent external engagement strategy that elevates the firm's research brand and talent pipeline.
* Partner with analytical, data, and infrastructure platform teams to unlock the capabilities researchers need – compute, models, tooling, and data – and ensure AI Research's priorities are represented in enterprise platform roadmaps.
* Champion responsible AI governance and a balanced application of controls – enabling the team to move fast, take smart risks, and innovate within a strong risk and compliance posture.
* Aid the talent strategy and operating fabric of the team – hiring, onboarding, workplace, and culture initiatives that make AI Research a destination for the best researchers in the world.




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5\+ years of business operations, COO, chief\-of\-staff, or strategy leadership experience – ideally supporting a research, technology, or highly technical organization.
* Track record as a trusted advisor to senior executives, translating vision into operating plans and driving cross\-functional execution.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen – multi\-year planning, resource allocation, and stewarding investment in innovation.
* Portfolio and prioritization instincts – able to focus a talented team on the highest\-impact work amid many competing demands.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; produces crisp executive narratives, board\-ready materials, and clear strategic updates.
* Sound judgment on risk, controls, and governance – with the instinct to balance speed of innovation with responsible execution.
* Highly organized, detail\-aware, and outcome\-driven, with a bias to action and calm under ambiguity.
* Collaborative operator who builds trust and influence across research, engineering, product, legal, finance, and business partners.
* Genuine curiosity about AI/ML and a passion for the mission of applying frontier research to real\-world financial services problems.
* Energized by enabling others – you take pride in making a world\-class team even more effective.

* Assist with promoting upcoming programs and events to current and prospective families

* Collaborate with school leadership on program improvements and new initiatives

Qualifications

* Strong organizational and time\-management skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just wait for instructions. Our ideal Program Coordinator can **anticipate needs, stay ahead of deadlines, communicate clearly, and take ownership of programs from planning through completion**.  

You should enjoy bringing ideas to life while making sure the details behind the scenes are handled smoothly.

new_jobs.title: Community Manager
new_jobs.description:
Description:
**Job Summary**


The Community Manager is responsible for the overall management and operation of an assigned property. The role includes ensuring property performance meets MMG Management’s standards and expectations in terms of occupancy, financial objectives, resident satisfaction, and overall maintenance. The Community Manager leads the on\-site team, oversees daily operations, and ensures the property runs smoothly while adhering to MMG’s mission and core values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Property Operations Management:
* Oversee daily operations of the property, ensuring compliance with MMG policies and procedures as well as local, state, and federal laws.
* Conduct regular property inspections to ensure a high standard of cleanliness, curb appeal, and maintenance.
* Conduct regular file audits to ensure and maintain compliance with MMG policies and procedures as well as local, state, and federal laws.
* Ensure completion of daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual tasks.
* Address resident concerns and resolve issues promptly and professionally to maintain a high level of resident satisfaction.
* Proactively develop solution plans for any identified problems or inefficiencies related to property operations, maintenance, or resident issues.
* Ensure timely and efficient execution of approved plans, following up on progress and making adjustments as necessary to meet property performance goals.


2\. Leasing \& Occupancy Management:

* Manage the leasing process to ensure high occupancy rates.
* Monitor market trends and recommend competitive rental pricing to maximize occupancy.
* Oversee and support leasing team efforts in handling inquiries, conducting tours, and securing new leases.
* Ensure timely processing and management of lease renewals and notices to vacate.


3\. Financial Management:

* Assist in development of and manage the property’s budget, ensuring financial goals are achieved.
* Monitor rent collections, delinquencies, and accounts receivable, acting to minimize loss and optimize revenue.
* Review financial reports, including rent rolls, profit and loss statements, and expense tracking, ensuring accuracy and performance alignment with company and ownership goals.
* Ensure invoices and bills are received accurately within 48 hours of services rendered or per scheduled timeline.
* Timely and accurate invoice and bill entry into property management software within 24 hours of receipt of invoices or billing statements.


4\. Maintenance \& Vendor Management:

* Coordinate and oversee maintenance requests, ensuring timely response and quality workmanship.
* Develop and maintain vendor relationships, negotiating contracts for services such as landscaping, cleaning, and repairs.
* Ensure preventive maintenance programs are implemented and executed consistently to maintain property value.
* Follow vendor selection and set up policies and procedures


5\. Leadership \& Team Growth:

* Provide leadership, ongoing training, and direction to the on\-site leasing and maintenance teams.
* Recruit, train, and onboard new team members in coordination with MMG Policies and standards.
* Conduct performance reviews, provide feedback, and ensure ongoing training and development.
* Foster a positive team environment, promoting MMG’s values of employee engagement and development.
* Prepare staff schedules to ensure optimized daily operations functionality and goals.
* Regularly conduct staff meetings discussing and implementing goals, job duties, achievements, and needs.
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting of employee paid hours, commission, bonuses, and other staff compensation items.


6\. Marketing \& Residential Retention:

* Develop and implement marketing strategies to attract new residents and retain current tenants.
* Organize and participate in resident events and initiatives to foster a sense of community and improve resident retention.
* Maintain a professional and approachable presence at the property to ensure excellent customer service and community relations.
* Become active in local business community to develop positive rapport.


7\. Compliance \& Risk Management:

* Ensure the property complies with Fair Housing laws and all other applicable regulations.
* Manage risk by adhering to safety protocols and addressing safety concerns on the property.
* Handle legal issues such as evictions, lease violations, and legal notices in accordance with MMG and local regulations with communication and collaboration with Regional Director and Portfolio Manager.


8\. Reporting \& Communication:

* Prepare and submit accurate and timely weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on occupancy, financial performance, maintenance activities, and other key metrics by deadlines.
* Maintain open communication with the Regional Property Director and Portfolio Manager, providing updates on property performance, challenges, and successes.

**Work Context:**


Communication:

* Required to frequently communicate efficiently, accurately, and timely via email, phone, or specified applications.


 Role Importance:

* Community Managers play a crucial role in overseeing all aspects of a financial asset while maintaining resident satisfaction. They are responsible for managing budgets, supervising staff, and ensuring the properties under their care are well\-maintained and profitable.


 Responsibility for Others:

* Community Managers are responsible for their teams. They are to uphold policy, assess deficiencies, ensure proper training, completion of tasks, and hold teams accountable for shortcomings.


Work Setting:

* Community Manager is an in\-office position to be done at a specific assigned location.


 Job Hazards:

* Possible hazardous conditions include but are not limited to: disgruntled tenants, disgruntled employee, mold, mildew, extreme temperatures.


 Work Attire:

* Business casual attire require. Please see personal appearance policy for specifications.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Role

Mabbly is a Chicago Go\-To\-Market Agency, and we are hiring an Account Manager to join our accounts team. You would work alongside our Strategy, Brand, Digital and Product Studios, all of them in the same building as you.

Let's be clear about what this is. We are looking for someone with roughly 2 to 3 years of agency or client\-facing experience who is sharp, malleable and hungry to grow. You would not be the last line of defense on an account. You would have a senior leader above you whose actual job is to make you better at this. Account Director is the destination, not the starting line.

If you have been waiting for a role where someone invests in your trajectory instead of handing you a static job description, this is it.

A word about who we are right now. Mabbly has been an agency for over a decade, but in the past year we rebuilt ourselves to operate like a startup. We run our entire business on Claude, Claude Cowork and Notion. We build our own internal AI agents. We automate anything that should not require a human. You will learn account management the way it is going to be practiced for the next decade, not the way it was practiced for the last one.

Honest note before you apply: this is an intense role inside a company in the middle of its biggest transformation ever. Priorities shift, the pace is real, and the people who thrive here find that energizing rather than exhausting. If you want a quiet seat and a settled playbook, this is not your job. If you want to help write the playbook and grow faster than any big agency would let you, keep reading.

What You Will Do Client partnership and communication

* Own daily client relationships. Build credibility by understanding each client's business, not just their deliverables.
* Run client meetings, calls and status updates with polish, and grow into leading presentations to senior stakeholders.
* Anticipate client questions before they arrive and bring solutions, looping in experts across our studios when needed.
* Prepare clean agendas, recaps, proposals and follow\-ups that keep projects moving.
* Chase what is stuck. A real part of this job is the polite, persistent follow\-up that stops a project sitting for three weeks waiting on one approval. We will teach you the cadence. You have to be willing to run it.

Execution and project ownership

* Manage planning and execution across campaigns, web builds, brand work and content.
* Keep client and internal teams aligned through every stage of the project lifecycle.
* Learn your clients' processes, including the ones that constrain us: approval chains, regulatory review, IT release windows. Knowing that a code change has to be submitted Wednesday to ship Friday is the difference between hitting a date and missing it.
* Work in the weeds. Everyone here does, including the founder.

Quality control

* Be the set of eyes before a client sees anything. Copy, links, formatting, brand consistency, and whether the work actually answers the brief.
* Build and maintain the checklist for your accounts, so quality does not depend on one person remembering.
* Send work back when it is not ready. This is harder than it sounds, and it is a large part of why clients renew.

Scope, budget and systems

* Translate signed work orders into real plans: deliverables and dates in Asana, hours in Harvest.
* Track contracted hours against hours used, and flag movement in both directions. Under\-delivery loses renewals. Over\-delivery loses margin.
* Keep a clear record of what was scoped, what was delivered and what remains, so anyone can answer the question without archaeology.

AI\-powered account operations

* Use Claude, Claude Cowork and Notion daily for meeting prep, recaps, reporting, research and client communication. We will train you. Curiosity is the prerequisite, not prior mastery.
* Help improve our internal AI agents and workflows. Spot something repetitive? We automate it, and you will be part of that.

Growth

* Learn to spot upsell opportunities inside your accounts and bring them forward.
* Take on increasing portfolio ownership as you prove it, on a defined path toward Account Director.
* Communicate account performance and wins to leadership regularly.

What Success Looks Like

We will not tell you to be "measurably more capable every quarter" and leave you to guess what that means. Here is what we actually watch, weekly.

* **Contracted deliverables due this week go out this week.**
* **Contracted hours land between 90 and 105 percent of what the client is entitled to.** Both ends of that band are failures, for different reasons.
* **Fewer than 20 percent of your client tasks are overdue** at any given moment.
* **Every account you touch has a conversation with someone senior on the client side at least every 30 days.**
* **Nothing reaches a client that you have not checked.**
* **Clients renew, and they use your name when they explain why.**

These numbers are on a scorecard the whole delivery team reads every week. You will always know where you stand, which is more than most agencies can say.

Within 18 to 24 months the goal is that you are operating at Account Director level, because we built you there on purpose.

What We Need In You

* **Experience.** 2 to 3 years in client management, account coordination or project management, ideally in an agency or marketing environment. Digital marketing familiarity strongly preferred.
* **Communication.** Excellent written and verbal skills, with the instinct to translate technical ideas for non\-technical audiences.
* **Attention to detail.** You are the person who catches the thing everyone else read past. If you have ever found the typo on the live site, tell us about it.
* **Coachability.** You seek feedback, absorb it fast and apply it. This matters more to us than your resume.
* **Organization.** Comfortable holding several accounts and many moving pieces without dropping any of them.
